tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi rnam thar phan bde'i 'byung gnas bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

/na mo gu ru bhyaḥ gang zhig bsam mi khyab pa'i sngon rol nas/ /legs sbyangs tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho rab bsags pas/ /rmad byung yon tan kun gyi pha mthar son| |rgyal ba 'bri gung rin chen phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcu'i zhing kun gtso bo bcom ldan 'das// ma 'khrul sna tshogs du ma'i mdzad pa can// rgyal dang rgyal sras ma lus kun gyi bdag /kun mkhyen skye dgu'i mgon po gang de rgyal// gang zhig gang gi mdzad pa mtha' yas las// su zhig su yis brjod pa'i yul 'das kyang*/ /bdag dang bdag gis dad pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// cung zad cung zad sgro skur spangs byas te// phan bde yon tan ma lus 'byung ba yi// bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po 'di nyid bri// 'di ltar phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa gcig tu 'dus pa'i bdag nyid/ rgyal sras sems dpa' rnams kyi gtso bo/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin cing*/ ji srid bstan pa rin po che gnas kyi bar du/ de srid phrin las mi zad pa'i thugs dam bzhes zhing mi mnyel bar dam bcas pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po de nyid/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar lung bstan pa de bzhin du/ gzigs pa rnam pa lnga'i sgo nas sems can gyi ris tshad med pa'i don du/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'dzam bu'i gling gi gangs can gyi rgyud 'dir 'phags mchog klu sgrub gnyis pa rgyal ba rin chen dpal zhes 'gru rgyal skyu ra'i rigs su 'khrungs shing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la tshul bzhin du bgyi ba bgyis te/ lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ sgro skur mtha' dag dang bral ba'i snying po'i bstan pa bslab pa rin po che gsum gyi sgo nas mkha' la nyi ma ltar gsal bar mdzad cing*/ gang zhig chos ltar bcos pa'i rgol ba mtha' dag chos kyi phyogs su zhi bar mdzad nas/ khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas su dam bcas pa ltar mngon du gyur pas bstan pa nye bar 'dzin pa'i skyes bu mi'i seng ge grol zhing slar grol ba sha stag la bstan pa nye bar gtad cing*/

chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du bzhugs nas ring zhig song ba na/ rgyal ba de nyid slar bsam bzhin du gdul bya'i lhag ma skyong ba'i phyir du/ snyigs ma'i snyigs ma rtog ge ba log lta'i bstan pa dar zhing snying po'i bstan pa cung zhig ngal ba'i dus 'dir/ rgyal dbang chen po 'di nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa tha mal mi'i gzugs su byon par gyur te/ de yang ji ltar lung bstan rnam thar dpag tu med pa ni sngon brjod kyi rnam thar rgyas pa la sogs las shes shing*/ 'dir ni shin tu gsang ba'i rnam thar rmad du byung ba 'ga' zhig dang*/ bdag cag la sogs pa'i bu chen slob ma rnams la/ rje de nyid kyis gnang ba'i gsang ba'i rnam thar snga phyi sogs las bkod pa'i rnam thar dang*/ mchog dman gyi mdzad pa sna tshogs bstan pa rnams dang*/ nges don chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor ba'i tshul rnams dang*/ de nyid sku'i dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings su bsdus pa nas dag pa dang ma dag pa'i snang brnyan sna tshogs bstan tshul dang*/ ma 'ongs par sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnams bzung nas sems can gyi don ji ltar mdzad pa sogs kyi bkod pa bstan tshul/ dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa ji ltar grub tshul rnams mdo tsam du brjod pa ni/ khyab bdag sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor los spras pa ni// srid gsum kun tu mtshungs pa ma mchis pa// zla bral kun dga'i nyi mas deng 'dir skyongs// sgyu 'phrul ye shes drwa ba'i sku brnyes zhing*// gzhom med tshangs dbyangs drug cu'i pha rol son// mkhyen gnyis dri med ye shes rgyal po nyid// rang byung kun dga'i nor bus 'dir skyongs shig /e ma khyod kyi thugs rje las// sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas// gdams pa'i dri bsung phyogs bcur 'phros// skal bzang bung bas bder spyod pa// khyod nyid gcig pu'i bka' drin lags// zhes smos nas/

de yang bdag cag la sogs pa'i skye dgu ma lus pa'i skyabs mgon mtshungs med 'gro ba'i bla ma de nyid 'das pa'i dus su yang bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sngon rol du de bzhin gshegs pa klu rigs sgron mar mngon par sangs rgyas kyang*/ slar yang gdul bya'i snang brnyan du mchog dman sna tshogs kyi sgo nas sprul par mdzad pa ni zhi khro rab 'byams sgyu 'phrul bkod par bstan nas/ ston pa gnyis pa klu sgrub mgon po sogs rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa du ma bsten nas theg pa mchog gi lam la gdul bya rnams bkod cing*/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gyi shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po rnams dang*/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po dge ba bcu'i khrims kyis gnya' shing 'dzin pa dag tu snang bar mdzad cing*/ ma rungs gdug pa can rnams 'dul bar mdzad pa'i phyir du/ slob dpon chen po padma saṃ bha wa la sogs par sprul nas snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdud par mdzad pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la tshul bzhin du slob pa'i phyir/ zung 'jug zab mo'i don lta sgom spyod pa gsum ya ma bral ba'i lam mchog gsal bar mdzad pa'i phyir du/ rgyal ba rin chen dpal dang*/ rgyal sras gcung sogs gdung brgyud 'dzin pa'i bla mar bstan nas thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzad pa dag ni sngon tshul gyi rnam par thar pa dag go// da lta byung ba'i mdzad pa'i rim pa bsdus tsam brjod pa ni/ nyid kyis ji ltar gsung ba dang*/ dam pa gzhan gyis bsngags shing brjod pa rnams ni rnam thar chen mo sogs las 'byung ba ltar dang*/ 'dir yang cung zad tsam smos na/ skye dgu'i mgon po thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid/ bsam bzhin du sprul pa'i skur 'byon par mdzad pa ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos nyid zab mo'i spyod yul bla na med pa ste/

de yang yul 'dzam 1bu tri sha'i grong khyer/ ljongs kha ba can gyi sa phyogs/ gzhu stod dpal gyi ti sgro'i nye logs/ sgru mkha' 'gro'i sgrub gnas/ pho brang chen po bkra shis steng khar/ yab rin chen chos rgyal dpal bzang po dang*/ yum ye shes mkha' 'gro rin chen dpal mo zhes pa'i sras su lug gi lor dge mtshan gyi dpal gyi yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'khrungs pa ni/ yab kyi bkra shis sgo mang bzhengs pa dang*/ yum gyi sku las dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor 'phros nas/ 'dzam gling khyab pa sogs ltas bzang po dpag tu med pa dngos dang rmi lam du byung ba sogs dang*/ de nyid sku bltams pa nas bkra shis dang bde legs sna tshogs kyis brgyan zhing*/ lha dang mi yi dpal 'byor mtha' dag gis spras shing*/ khyad par 'bri gung pa'i sde srid thams cad kyang rdzogs ldan gyi dus ltar gnas par gyur cing*/ khyad par rgyal ba 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i lugs mtha' dag ches cher gsal bar gyur nas/ rim gyis sku skyed srings nas tshan po che yi shugs ltar mthu dang rtsal drag tu rdzogs la/ bka' srung rnams dang lha klu thams cad kyis zhabs 'bring bsgrub pa dang*/ khyad par dam can rdo rje legs pas skyob pa nyid la ji ltar sgrub pa bzhin mngon du gyur pa dang*/ dgung lo bzhi lnga nas zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin las mi g.yel shing*/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung bas/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa rang byung du thugs las 'khrungs shing*/ byis pa'i dus na'ang*/ 'gro ba gzhan dag la legs nyes 'byed pa'i chos kyi sgo sna tshogs kyis 'chad nyan gyi rnam pa'i rol rtsed kyis rgyud grol bar mdzad pa ni ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar dpag med mnga' bzhin pas/ dgung lo bcu pa'i bar du bzhugs nas/ de'i dus yab chos kyi dbyings su gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs rnams legs par bsgrub pa'i zhal bkod kyi rim pa rnams bsgrubs pa dang*/

sku la sib bu'i snyung gzhi byung ba'i dus/ sku la zug gzer chen po byung ba yang sgyu ma'i rol rtsed kyis rnam pas rtsal sbyangs shing*/ de'i dus bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla mngon sum du zhal gzigs shing rjes su gnang ba yang mdzad do// de nas nyid kyi khu bo chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du rim gyis skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ lam rim rnams la zhugs shing*/ so so'i bslab bya phan yon dang bcas pa la sbyangs/ skyob pa rin po che'i dgongs pa thugs bskyed rin po che phyag khrid dang bcas nas dgongs pa mtha' dag mtha' chod par mdzad/ gzhan yang dpal mgon po'i rgyud rgya gzhung khrid rim sogs thams cad rdzogs par zhus/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i dus dpal karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho dang mjal zhing lugs gnyis kyi dga' ston la bde bar spyad do// dgung lo bcu gsum la slar yang dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po nyid la 'bri gung pa'i chos skor ji snyed pa bka' rdzogs lung rdzogs dang*/ gzhan yang 'phags yul grub pa'i gzhung lugs kyi rgya gzhung tshad ldan rnams dang bcas pa mtha' chod par thugs su chud par mdzad do// dgung lo bcu bzhi pa'i dus slar yang rgyal ba'i dbang po chos grags rgya mtsho nyid la mjal ba dang chos lung sogs kyis thugs dgongs gcig pa'i sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa tshul bzhin du 'dzin pa'i bgro ba mdzad do// dgung lo bcu bdun la nges 'byung gi bsam pa rnam par dag pas paṇa chen shākya shrī yi ring lugs skyong ba'i chos lung tshogs pa spyan drangs nas/ mkhan po dgra bcom pa kun dga' blo gros dang mkhan slob sogs dge 'dun grangs tshang gi dbus su dge tshul gyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa thob par mdzad cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la gces spras su mdzad do// gzhan yang mtshungs bral gyi 'dren mchog rnams dang*/ gzhung dang man ngag ston pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams la brten nas/

nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan du mas rtags bcu yon tan brgyad sogs mtha' dag gi pha rol tu son par mdzad do// de dag gi bar mtshams su yang yongs 'dzin shrī dbang ratna'i drung du/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa nyams khrid dang*/ zab lam nā ro chos drug gsan pa'i dus bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi myong ba khyad par can rgyud la 'khrungs shing*/ nyams mgur mdzad pa dang*/ rje nyid ye shes mgon por gsal bar bstan pa'i zlos gar mdzad pa ni/ zhabs drung du bzhugs pa'i nye gnas dag gis mthong zhes zer ro// dgung lo bco brgyad bzhes pa nas bcu dgu pa'i bar zab mo'i rnal 'byor dang 'chad nyan sogs las mi g.yel bar bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad do// glang gi lor dpal khra ba kha'i gnas mchog tu/ yongs 'dzin shrī dbang ratna sogs kyi bka' drin che ba'i bla ma bcu phrag gcig gis grangs dang ldan pa'i drung du/ gdams pa dang nye ba'i gdams pa sogs kyi pha rol tu son par mdzad cing*/ dpal mgon po gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu gtso 'khor brgyad zhal gzigs pa sogs gsang sngags phyi nang gi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa zhal gzigs so// dgung lo nyi shu bzhes pa'i lo la slar chos lung tshogs pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang gi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad cing 'dul ba'i bslab bya chos tshul mtha' dag gi phyag len gzhung bshad rnams legs par khong du chud par mdzad nas/ de ka'i lor dpal 'bri gung byang chub kyi gling gi chos kyi mtho ba'i gser khang du/ rgyal ba 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i chos kyi seng ge'i khri mngon par mtho ba la/ nyid sku tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis rab tu brjid pa gang de'i 'khor los mtshan pa'i zhabs gnyis mngon par bkod nas/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad la dbang bskur bar rgyal ba rnams kyis shis pa'i me tog 'thor bas/ srid gsum thams cad kyi bla ma'i bla mar gyur pa ni rgyal bas bsngags cing gtsug gi rgyan du gyur pa'o// bshes gnyen rgyu skar mang shar yang*// kun dga'i nyi ma 'di med na// gangs can 'di ni mtshan mor 'dzin// kun dga'i nyi ma 'di shar bas// gangs can 'di yang gsal bar mdzad// ces gsol to// de ltar skye dgu'i mgon po chen po 'di nyid kyis dal ba med pa'i sgo nas sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che 'phel zhing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir du/

bsdu bzhi'i sgo nas chos dang mthun par bskyangs pas/ sa chen po 'di yi bdag po bla na med pa chos kyi rgyal po chen po chos dang nye bar sbyor ba'i ded dpon gang des nyer gcig lon pa yos kyi lo la gser khang du 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu la theg pa chen po'i chos kyi sgo mo mtha' yas pas rigs ldan gyi skyes bu dag la rnam par grol ba'i sa bon 'debs pa'i tshul du smin pa dang grol ba'i lam gyi zab gnad/ nā ro chos drug gis nyams khrid du mdzad pas drod kyi lang tsho ngom pa'i ras pa brgya phrag mang po dag gis bla g.yel chen mor ras phud mdzad pa la dngos po'i gnang sbyin dpag tu med pa dang*/ dus rung gi bza' ba sna tshogs/ ro mchog du ma dang ldan pa'i btung ba sogs gzhal du ma mchis pa dag gis tshim par mdzad cing rgyun mi 'chad du chag med kyi dgun chos dang*/ dbyar chos kyi rim pa dang*/ nyams len gtso bor 'don pa'i sgrub pa po rnams kyis lo gsum phyogs gsum gyis bug sgo 'dag sbyar dang*/ ngag smra bcad sogs dam bca' 'bul ba'i sgrub sde bsam gtan gyi khang bu brgya phrag dang bshad sgrub lag len grwa pa ngo mtshar ba'i sde 'dzugs pa sogs bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs po che kho na mdzad pas/ rang gzhan gyi yid kyi dpal 'byor rgyas par gyur to// smras pa/ dpal ldan rigs brgya'i gtso bo rdo rje 'chang*// snyigs dus 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog rin po che// thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' rin chen zhes// snyan pa'i ba dan srid gsum g.yo ba can// gang de'i mdzad pas nam mkha'i lto ba 'gengs// phrin las mi zad srid mthar rgyas pa dang*// 'gro ba'i yid kyi re ba tshim par mdzad// gzhan yang bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyis bstan pa rin po che la ris med pa'i thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcad pa'i phyir/ gzhung lugs brgya phrag smra ba chen po rnams dang*/ zab mo rtsa rlung rten 'brel gyi gnad la dbang bsgyur ba mngon shes rig pa'i pha rol tu son pa rnams la de nyid kyi man ngag gab pa mtha' dag kyang ji lta ba bzhin mtha' chod dmar khrid lag len zhal shes dang bcas pa rnams dang*/

gzhan yang de dang de dag gi don la mngon du ma mdzad pa'am/ khong du ma chud pa med de/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la ston pa gnyis pa lta bur mnga' bar mdzad pa ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i rnam par thar pa bla na med pa ste/ thub bstan rin chen khang bzang mthon po la// mi ngal thos bsam rgyal mtshan mngon 'dzin pas// bstan 'dzin nang na yid bzhin tog ltar mdzes// sgrub brgyud mi nub rgyal mtshan dam pa rgyal// de ltar mtha' yas pa'i skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan du rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i lugs gnyis kyi dpal 'byor dang mnga' ris thams cad chos dang mthun par bsdu ba bzhi'i sgo nas bskyangs pas thams cad kyang phan tshun du 'jigs pa mtha' dag dang bral nas/ lam dang sa thob pa lta bu sha stag tu gyur pa ni/ thams cad kyis rin po che nyid kyi bka' drin yin zhes phyogs bcur snyan pa'i ba dan sgrog par byed do// de ka'i mod la skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i zab lam zung 'jug gi dgongs pa gtso bor ston pa'i dgongs 'grel gyis 'dus pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud grol bar mdzad cing*/ nyid kyi sku'i mdzad pa ni tshul khrims rin po che dang bskyed rim lhun gyis grub pa dbyer med kyi sgo nas mig 'khrid par mdzad pa dang*/ gsung gi mdzad pa grags stong zung 'jug gi sgo nas gang la gang 'tsham gyi gsung gis sems can gyi rgyud grol ba dang thar pa'i sa bon 'jog par mdzad pa dang*/ thugs kyi mdzad pa ni sems can thams cad byams pa dang*/ snying rje byang chub kyi sa bon stong nyid snying rje dbyer med kyi lam la bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes kyi sems can gyi khams la bzhugs par mdzad do// yon tan gyi che bas dam pa gzhan dang gzhan gyi rtsod pas mi brdzi zhing*/ mthong thos dran rig gis thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa bon skrun par mdzad cing phrin las kyi dpal 'bar bas 'dzam bu gling pa'i sum gnyis kyi dpal dang 'byor pa longs spyod kyi dngos po dbyar sprin bzhin du dpal 'bri gung byang chub gling 'dir 'dus par gyur pa ni/

las tshan chen po bco brgyad/ rgyal sa chen po bcu gsum la dbang bsgyur nas/ gong ma'i bka' srol rlabs po che mtha' dag ches cher rgyas par gyur cing*/ skyob pa rin po che nyid kyi dus ji lta bar chos dang*/ 'jig rten gyi dga' ston bla na med pas 'gro ba mtha' dag gi yid kyi shing rta gang nas rje 'di nyid skyob pa dngos su byon pa ni bdag cag rnams kyi bsod nams kyi dpal du shar bas bsags pa dang ldan pa'o zhes gleng bar gyur to// de lta bas na skyabs mchog 'di nyid kyis gangs can gyi gnas gsum gyi ri thems rdo rje 'dzin pa dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa dngos pos mi phongs pa'i gnang sbyin rgya chen po dang bcas nas lan du mar brdzangs pa dang*/ mnga' ris skor gsum gyi 'bul dpon dang*/ mdo smad rgya nag dal du yi 'bul dpon/ phur tsha khag gsum sogs kyi 'bul ba/ hor ser kha gsum gyi rta 'bul rnams bzhes pa'i bkod pa/ khan khras gsum gyis mgos byas lan bzhir rdzongs bkod 'bul bzhes rnams dang*/ grwa pa dpag tu med pa'i gtsug phud bzhes pa sogs bstan pa'i rgyun chags spel bar mdzad do// de ltar longs spyod kyi dngos po rnams la snying po len zhing dkon mchog gsum rgyun mi 'chad par bya ba'i phyir dkar phyogs kyi mthu la mngon par brtson pa'i stobs rgyas par mdzad nas/ lo re bzhin yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs lugs su blugs pa dang*/ ri mo bris pa sogs rin po che'i rigs kho nas khyab par mdzad cing*/ khyad par 'brug gi lo la mthing shog dri ma med pa la rin po che gser dngul gyis gsang sngags rgyud 'bum chen mo rnying ma'i rgyud grangs tshang dang bcas pa nyi shu zhus dag glegs shing rtsi gras sogs ngo mtshar bar rab tu gnas pa dang bcas zla ba gcig gi nang du mngon par grub par mdzad cing*/ slar yang*/ yang dgon chos kyi pho brang du chos kyi 'khor lo legs par bskor zhing*/

nges pa don gyi sgo nas snying po'i bstan pa stong nyid rgyu 'bras kyi rnam par bzhag pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i thugs kyi nying khu rnams nor 'khrul dpe mkhyud med par bstan pas/ thams cad kyang dal 'byor sdong po la sgrub pa'i 'bras bu dang*/ me tog 'khrungs pas sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa rnams tshul bzhin du bsam gtan la gnas pa dang*/ phyag len gsar pa'i sgrub dkyil rin po che khungs btsun pa dag gis srol 'dzugs pa dang*/ mdor na bslab bya rin po che dag gis spang bya mtha' dag rgyang ring du dor zhing*/ blang bar bya ba'i chos la blo gros kyi mig gsar du rgyas par gyur to// de ka'i mod la 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan rin chen pa'i phyi rten du sku 'bum chen mo gser gdugs gser 'phru dang bcas pa rab gnas kyi byin chags par mdzad do// gzhan yang rje nyid khang gsar sgom pas byams chen bzhengs pa'i rab gnas dang*/ stag lung du mi dpon tshe dbang grags pa 'das pa'i gral dbu sogs la phebs pas lha mi thams cad kyi rtsod pa dang bral ba'i bkur sti rim gro phul du phyin pa bsgrubs shing*/ lcags pho spre'u yi lo la skyid shod du/ sa skyong chen po don yod rdo rjes spyan 'dren zhus shing de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog yan lag gis rnam 'phrul zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa bzhi pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po dang phyogs gcig tu gdan 'dzom pa'i bkod pa sbyin bdag chen po de nyid kyis mngon par bshams nas/ spyan 'dren gyi pho nya btang bas rje 'di nyid kyang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas nas sgar chen rim gyis phebs pa las/ de'i dus su/ than pa chen po 'jigs su rung bas myu gu dang*/ rtsi shing thams cad bskams shing chu bo rnams kyang so sor yibs par gyur pa na/ skye bo thams cad mgrin gcig tu gsol ba btab pas/ sgar pas 'brom stod du phebs dus sprin gsar pa'i ser bu ldang nas char gyi rgyun chen po bab pas/

lo 'bras dang rtsi shing thams cad rab tu rgyas par gyur nas/ skye bo thams cad dad pa'i myu gu gsar du bskyed par mdzad do// de'i dus su sa skyong chen po de nyid kyis kyang*/ bsu ba dang bkur sti rim gro sna tshogs kyi khri la blangs shing snang 'tshal padmo yi tshal du bzhugs shing*/ 'phrul snang zhing gi gzhal yas khang chen por seng ge'i khri bkod pa mchog la rgyal dbang de gnyis so sor gdan bkod pa la zhal 'dzoms par lha dang mi'i mchod pa sna tshogs dang*/ dus rung gi bza' ba dang lo ma'i btung ba sogs kyis bsnyen bkur sgrub cing*/ dam pa gnyis kyang byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i mdzad pas gcig gis gcig la bstod bkur dang*/ snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrog pa kho na mdzad pas/ der gnas pa'i skye dgu thams cad thar pa'i sa bon 'jog par mdzad do// rje 'di nyid kyis rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid la gus pa lhur blangs nas zhabs la btud cing rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad ngoms pa med cing thos bsam phul du phyin par mdzad cing*/ smin byed rgyud sde'i dbang rnams dang*/ grol byed rdzogs rim zab mo rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi gdams pa grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug la sogs gzhung dang rgyud 'grel dpag tu med pa mthar son par mdzad cing*/ so sor longs spyod dpag tu med pas dgyes pa dang bde bar spyod par mdzad pas/ sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i bgro ba phul du phyin par gnang nas slar yang jo shāka rnams la lha dang mi'i mchod sprin dpag tu med cing gzhal du med pa'i mar me dang snyan dar/ rin po che btso ma'i gser chab gsol zhing*/ smon lam rgya mtsho lta bu spel ba dang thugs bskyed rin po che yang dang yang du bzhes pa na/ jo bo rin po che'i sku dang smin mtshams nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung nas nyid la thim pa dang*/ jo bo bcu gcig zhal las kyang 'od zer dmar po yi tshan pa dang 'ja' tshon lta bu byung ste rje yi thugs khar dngos su thim pa dang*/

gzhan yang nam mkha' la 'ja' kha dog sna lnga'i tshogs dang*/ me tog gi char chen po bab pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mi mngon tsam dang*/ nyi ma la 'ja' tshon sna lngas bskor ba'i gur dang bla bres lta bu byung zhing zhabs 'bring ba rnams kyis kyang*/ mthong snang mi 'dra ba du ma byung ba ni/ kha cig gis rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs su mthong ba dang*/ kha cig gis thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor du mthong ba dang nyid kyi thugs snang la/ bcom ldan 'das la 'khor dgra bcom pa mang pos bskor ba dag gis rten 'brel snying po dang*/ rgyun chags gsum pa dngos su gsung ba'i snang ba byung ba dang*/ kong bu'i dbus kyi mar me'i dkyil na byams pa chos 'chad mdzad pa la nye ba'i sras brgyad kyis bskor bar gzigs pa dang*/ yang de dus rje 'di nyid kyis/ rgyal dbang chos kyi grags pa mgon po 'od dpag med longs sku'i rnam pa can du gzigs pa dang*/ gzhan dag thams cad kyis rje 'di nyid mgon po ser po dang*/ rnam sras su mthong ba ni mang por byung zhing*/ de'i dus su chu bo'i ri la phyag nas mdzad pas lo grangs mang por chu bo phar log pa sogs ngo mtshar ba dpag tu med pa sha stag byung bas/ der gnas pa'i skye dgu thams cad kyis rje nyid la gus pa gtso bor byed pa kho na lhur len pa dang*/ shis pa brjod pa sha stag tu mdzad nas slar sprul pa dang bsgyur ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rtags du ma mdzad pa 'di yang sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyod yul zab mo kho na'i chos nyid ste/ sngon gyi rgyal ba gcung dang don grub rgyal po la sogs pa rnams kyis grub rtags kyi sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa la/ rgyal ba 'di nyid kyis gsung gi gsang ba zab mo yi sgo nas grol bar mdzad na sa skyong chen po des kyang zhabs spyi bor blangs shing*/ bka' chos dpag tu med pa gsan/ dngos po ngo mtshar zhing rin thang che ba mang po dang*/ khrims dge ba bcu'i khas len phul nas phyag 'tshal sgang bar skyel thung mdzad cing*/

rje 'di nyid kyis kyang bka' bsgo sogs mdzad nas/ slar 'bri gung byang chub gling gi mtshe'u khar phebs nas dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu skyong ba la mi ngal bar bzhugs so// skabs su sgar chen byang rigs su phebs shing*/ sgom khyung sogs sde rigs rnams kyis rtsod pa rnams zhi ba'i bsdum dang gnang sbyin sogs mdzad/ de dag gis kyang dngos po gang yod phyag tu btang zhing thams cad kyang dkar phyogs la gzhol bar gyur to// de'i dus byang nam ra sogs su phebs pa las/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran par gyur cing nam ra 'khor dang bcas pas zhabs 'bring bsgrub pa dngos sam nyams snang du mdzad pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'jig rten 'di'i mi dang mi ma yin lha klu gnod sbyin gyis kyang rje nyid la 'dud de zhabs 'bring bsgrubs shing rgyal ba 'di nyid 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i seṅge'i khri la bzhugs pa nas dbus gtsang sogs thams cad kyi sde 'khrug rtsod pa rnams kyang zhi/ lo tog 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa smin cing*/ bde skyid kyi dpal 'byor phyogs thams cad du rgyas par gyur cing*/ rje rin po che 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs la bsdo ba ltar snang ba'i sne'u gdong pa sde ris dang bcas pa dang*/ kong long nyang gsum sogs na yang bsdo ba ltar snang ba rnams la yang thams cad la sdang ba med cing snying rjes rjes su bzung yang thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams kyis ni chos kyi dbyings su bsgral nas rnam shes bde ba can du spar bar mdzad do// de'i phyir rje 'di nyid ni phrin las bzhi la mnga' bsgyur bar nges so// de bas na tshigs su bcad nas smras pa// skye dgu'i mgon po dpal ldan 'bri gung pa// sa gsum dbang phyug rgyal dbang kun dga'i mtshan// rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po// gang de'i rnam thar rmad byung grangs med pas// rgyal dang rgyal ba'i bstan la rab gus nas// bshes gnyen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag du ma bsten// lung rtogs yon tan khur gyis rab brjid cing*// gzhan phan rlabs chen spyod la mi ngal bar// phan bde sna tshogs thabs kyis sbyor mkhas pas// 'gro ba ma lus thar pa'i gnas la bkod// rgyal ba 'jig rten mgon po'i ring lugs dag

/de snyed gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me 'dzin// bslab gsum yon tan khur gyi lci ba yis// gzhung brgya smra dang yang dag 'jog la sogs// rigs dang grol ba'i 'phags pa'i sras kyi mchog /'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu dge ba'i bshes// brgya phrag byon dang bzhud pa mi mngon pa'i// 'khor tshogs 'phags pa'i ldum ra ltar mdzes la// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa zab mo'i gnad bsdus pa// snang ba rang sems stong nyid rgyu 'bras dang*// sdom gsum gnad gcig bcu chos sum chos dang*// la dor lam gtong bsre ba'i zab don sogs// 'khor lo gsum gyi snying po lnga ldan sogs// khyad 'phags grub mtha'i sgo rnams gsal ba dang*// nyams len srog 'khor skyes sbyor chos drug gis// rgyud grol rtogs ldan rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// gangs can ri bo'i gnas rnams khyab gyur te// ti se dang ni shing kun tsā ri dang*// la phyi la sogs yongs grags gnas chen dang*// ma grags ri sul shing drung gad phug sogs// khyod kyi bu chen slob ma'i tshogs kyis gang*// sgrub brgyud rgyu skar bdag po khyod shar bas// gangs can dkar po'i lam bzang rnyed gyur nas// snying po'i bstan pa dar ba khyod kyi drin// de phyir khyod la snying nas gus phyag 'tshal// khyod kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba ni// mi zad nam mkha'i lto ba khengs gyur nas// lha mi'i dpal 'byor char ltar 'bab pa la// snying po len phyir sku gsung thugs kyi rten// rnam mang bzhengs dang zhig pa gso ba sogs// bstan la bya ba rlabs chen sgrub pa dang*// 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams bsdu ba bzhi yis bskyangs// 'khor tshogs bzhi po rnam grol sa la bkod// rgyal ba rgya mtshos byin rlabs lung bstan thob// srung ma rgya mtshos phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrubs// lha klu rnams kyis mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// gnod sbyin tshogs kyis 'dod dgu char bzhin phab// yul lha'i tshogs kyis gus pas zhabs 'bring bsgrubs// 'jig rten gsum na mtshungs med khyod zhabs la// ma btud pa ni gang yang yod min na// de phyir rgyal ba khyod nyid bdud bzhi las// rnam par rgyal bas mtshan don mtshungs gyur pas// thub chen dpa' bo srid gsum bla ma'i bla// gong mar gyur pa 'dren pa rin po che// bstan pa 'di la dus gsum khyod lta bu// 'dren pa ma byung 'byung bar yong mi 'gyur// dus gsum mkhyen pa'i skyabs chen gang de rgyal// de lta mod kyis mtshungs med 'di nyid kyis// bstan pa'i sgron me 'dzam gling gtsug gi rgyan// thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin// paṇa chen gzhung brgya smra ba du ma dang*// gnyis med gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// skye 'chi rang dbang thob pa'i grub chen rnams// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thob pa du ma bsten// chos kyi ded dpon chen por dbang bsgyur nas// chos kyi phrin las bzang po srid mthar skyong*// zhes smras so// de yang dus gsum gyi ston pa/

sa gsum gyi bla ma/ bdag cag thams cad kyi rnam 'dren/ thar pa'i gling du 'khrid pa'i ded dpon chen po nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rnam par thar pa cha shas re res kyang dpag tu med pa'i gnas sha stag ste/ de yang rje 'di nyid kyis rmad du byung ba'i mdzad pa gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog par seng ge lta bu'i nyam nga dang brdzi ba med par mdzad pa ni/ dpal 'bri gung byang chub gling gi chos dang 'jig rten gyi khur thams cad nyid kyis mdzad pas/ gling rin po che'i zhig gsos/ sgo mang rnams dang*/ sku 'bum 'dzam gling rgyan gyis thog drangs/ rten gsum nyams chag dang zhig ral du song ba rnams slar legs par gsos nas 'gro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa'i rten du gsar du bzhengs pa lta bu sha stag tu mdzad pa dang*/ gling gi stod du sgrub sde rgyab pa rmad du byung ba gsar rgyag kyi grwa spel grwa khral brgya phrag la bshad grwa dang phyag len gyi grwa sa 'dzugs pa/ dgon sde gzhan rnams la'ang bla ma'i bsko bzhag bshad sgrub kyi rnam gzhag gi khyab che bar mdzad de/ mdor na 'bri gung gi gling 'di la 'jig rten gyi gang stong byung ba la/ bcu gnyis rin po che bka' drin che bar 'dug la/ de'i rjes su rten 'brel gyi dbang gis bstan pa 'phel 'grib chen po byung nas dpal 'bri gung pa'i bstan pa mi gnas pa lta bur gyur pa la/ rje 'di nyid khri rin po che'i mtshan gsol nas/ 'bri gung pa'i bstan dang*/ grub mtha' chos spyod kyi rim pa phyag len sogs bor ba rnyed pa lta bu sgo du ma nas gsal bar mdzad nas/ chos kyi bstan pa gsar chags su rgyas pas log lta can kha cig phrag dog cing 'phya kha gtong*/ skyob pa rin po che'i bstan pa la mos pa'i mdo dbus kyi grwa pa dad can rnams ni skyabs bral gyis mgon rnyed pa lta bu dang*/ sred ldan gyi bus sred thob pa lta bur gyur nas/ longs spyod kyi sum gnyis phyag tu btang zhing rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par gyur te/

de yang dngos po de dang de dag la snying po len par byed pa'i phyir du/ rdo rje 'chang nas skyob pa yan gyi bka' 'bum tshang ma mthing shog la rin po che gser dngul gyis 'bur du bzhengs pa'i glegs bam grangs mang ba dang*/ rgyud rigs yang snying rnam bzhi rgya shog gan ma la gser gyis 'bur chen du bzhengs pa'i po ti gcig dang*/ rgya gzhung grub snying skor gser dngul gyis bzhengs pa po ti gnyis sogs grangs mang*/ skyob pa yab sras kyi dgongs pa'i nying khu zab chos po ti gnyis/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig pa spyan snga rdo rje shes rab kyi 'grel bshad la rgyas pa po ti gnyis dang*/ mdo rgyud thams cad kyi tshig don gsal bar byed cing zab mo lnga ldan gyi 'grel pa theg pa chen po bstan pa'i snying po po ti gnyis/ thugs kyi snying po tsin ta ma ṇi rin po che 'bar ba'i 'grel bshad rgyal dwangs pas mdzad pa po ti gcig theg pa chen po'i tshul zhes bya ba'i 'grel bshad dam chos 'ong ge mar grags pa glegs bam gcig tu byas pa rnams mthing shog la rin po che gser dngul gyis 'bur du bris pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang bka' brgyud rin po che'i grub thob gong ma phal cher gyi bka' 'bum dang gsung sgros re mang rnams kyang bzhengs shing*/ dpal rdo rje 'chang bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i bla ma rin po che rnams kyi re re bzhin gyi rnam thar gyi thang sku chen mo grabs tshad ma mtha' dag gser thang du byas pa la lha'i gos dar sna tshogs kyis gong bsham zhal khebs sogs ngo mtshar ba sha stag gis spras pa dang*/ gzhan yang lo re re bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs mang po dang*/ gsung rab phran bu mang po bzhengs pa la ni mtha' mi mngon no// de yi dus gcen po rin chen rnam rgyal bas ni sgom pa'i thugs khur bzhes la/ gcung po chos kyi rgyal po bas ni dbon gyi go sar bzhugs shing*/

rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal pos ni bya bral gyi brtul zhugs kyis bstan pa'i sgron me 'dzin par mdzad/ rje btsun sgrol ma dkar sngon gyi sprul pa yum chen gnyis kyis ni so so'i gzhis khar zab mo'i rnal 'byor lhur len pa kho na las gzhan mi mnga' zhing*/ rje rin po che 'di nyid kyis rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i lugs gnyis kyi lam srol ji snyed pa gso ba'i khur bzhes nas 'dzin skyong spel ba la skad cig kyang mi g.yel bar dus 'da' bar mdzad pa de yang 'jig rten na rtsod pa dang bral bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ slar gar dbang rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo karma pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po de nyid 'bri gung byang chub kyi gling rin po che mjal ba dang*/ rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po nyid dang bstan pa'i bgro ba gleng bar mdzad par bzhed pas/ 'dus pa rgya mtsho dang bcas pas khyi lo la phebs pa la/ rje nyid kyis rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul mdzad nas/ bsu ba dang zhabs 'bring gi khri la blangs nas dpal mtshe'u khar phyag phebs nas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang bye brag gdams pa dang nye ba'i gdams pa dpag tu med pa gsan cing*/ gsung rab thams cad kyi bdag po chen por mnga' gsol zhing*/ gling phyi nang gi rten gsum rnams la'ang mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing smon lam rnam par dag pas sprul nas sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong gi bgro ba gnang nas thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par mdzad nas/ slar bde chen yangs pa can du sgrub sde chen po 'debs pa'i bgro ba mdzad do// rin po che 'di nyid kyis kyang dngos po dpag tu med pa'i don sbyin pa dang*/ snyan par smra ba'i sgo nas dang*/ yid tshim pa'i sgo nas don ltar spyod pa'i lam la bkod cing*/ don mthun pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam grangs mtha' yas pas rigs mthun gyi skye bo de dag phyir mi ldog pa'i lam la bkod pa ni byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis mdzad pa rlabs po che 'gro ba mtha' dag gi dmigs rten dam par gyur to// de lta bus ni skyob pa 'di nyid ston pa dngos su byon pa rtsod pa dang bral bar mngon no// de ltar yang rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyis lung bstan cing rjes su gnang bar mdzad pa ni/

dbu ru ka tshal gyi gnas su rje btsun bcu gcig zhal mngon par gzigs nas 'gro ba rnams smin cing grol bar gyis shig pa'i dbugs dbyung bar mdzad nas/ snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba mi bsrun pa dag gis thugs mi skyo bar ngal ba spangs nas sems can gyi don sgrubs shig ces dang*/ dpal khra ba kha'i gnas su zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor zhal gzigs shing lung bstan par mdzad do// yang dus gcig gi tshe rmi lam du bka' brgyud bla ma mang po zhal gzigs shing de dag gi nang nas/ dwags po rin po che dngos dang mjal nas/ mu tig snyim pa gang gnang nas/ 'di khyod kyi grwa pa yin pas na/ ma god par gyis shig pa'i gnang ba sbyin pa dang*/ lung bstan par mdzad pa dang*/ yang sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i bsam gtan gyi khang bu'i thun bar du bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po mtshan dpes spras pa zhal gzigs shing*/ don gnyis lhun gyis grub par dbang bskur bar mdzad nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod rgyal po'i sras kyi thu bo zhes nam mkha' las byang chub sems dpa' phyed gtsug can zhig gis rnam par bsgrags so// de ltar rtags bcu yon tan brgyad sogs mtha' dag la dbang bsgyur ba ni mchog grub pa'i dbang phyug nyid du mngon nas lung bstan thob par mdzad do// de ltar dngos dang rmi lam nyams snang sogs la lung bstan dpag tu med pa thob par gyur pa ni/ mnyam med chos rje dbang ratna'i mtshan can gyis kyang*/ khyed kyis spyir gyi bstan pa rin po che la spel rgyas/ de dag gi rtsa ba gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing zhig gsos byed pa/ khyad par mgon khang rnying ma 'di la bdag rkyen zhig bgyis dang*/ phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa'i grogs su 'gyur bas mi g.yel bar mdzod/ ces bgo bar gnang bas/ rje 'di nyid dpal mgon pos rjes su bzung zhing phrin las thogs med du sgrub pas/ yang nas yang du zhal gzigs shing*/

khyad par mgon khang 'di nyid la rdo sku rin po che 'di dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal du rang byon du byung ba klu sgrub gyis gdan drangs/ rim par rgyud de dpal rga los bod du spyan drangs/ ye shes mgon po dngos su 'dug pas/ de dag gi drung du phyi nang gi rten rdzas dpag par dka' ba'i go mtshon rin thang can brgya phrag dang*/ stag gzig dom gsum sogs gcan gzan gyi pags pa sna tshogs/ rin po che'i bye brag mang po gter ltar spungs shing*/ lha mi'i mchod rdzas du ma dang*/ gzhan yang grub chen mang po'i byin rlabs dang rab gnas chags pa'i sku gzugs 'bur dod ras bris mang po dang*/ slob dpon padma'i phyag mtshan rdo rje dang phur pa lha dngos su 'khor ba mang po khyad par gter mgon yab yum 'di nyid rje rin po che'i thugs dam gtso bor mdzad cing dngos grub rnam bzhi dngos su thob par gyur pas/ de'i sgrub rdzas rnams dang bcas pas brtan bzhugs dang mnga' gsol dpag tu med pa yang nas yang du mdzad pas gsol ba gdab na phrin las sgrub pa dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal dang mtshungs nges pa'i bkod pa dang*/ dus gnyan po thams cad du dgu gtor dang mnga' gsol/ bya ba chen po nam dgos pa'i dus rje nyid kyis bka' bsgos pas ji ltar bzhed bzhin mngon sum du gyur pa ni bdag cag rnams kyis kyang mngon sum du rngo thogs pa kho na'o// gzhan yang gzim khang stod smad/ gser khang phyi nang rnams dang*/ lha khang chen mo rnams kyang bar skabs bdag rkyen med pa'i dbang gis zhig grum du song ba rnams kyang gsos zhing rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dang mtshungs pa'i bkod pa mdzad do// gzhan yang rje 'di nyid thugs dam zab mo'i rnal 'byor nyin zhag phrugs gcig gam/ lo gcig gis dkar phyogs kyi dge ba'i mtshan ma dang bcas pa dang*/ zag pa med pa 'bral med du sgrub tshul ni/ snga thun dang po la tho rangs rdo rje'i glus bskul ba'i rnal 'byor gyis bzhengs nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga gsum 'brel ba bzhes pa nas/

he ru ka lhan skyes kyi rim pa bsgom bzlas bar du rgya gar dzo ki'i srung zlog dang tshe sgrub gsang sngags rnying ma'i srung zlog dang rdzas sngags/ sgom chen klu mes kyi tshe sgrub dang ras chung lugs kyi tshe sgrub rlung 'dzin dang rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dang*/ mgon dkar rga lo dang*/ rtswa mi lugs kyi tshe sgrub/ gu ru mtsho skyes lugs kyi sgrub pa chen mo/ gcod la thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor/ bde mgon gyi mngon dkyil sgrub thabs/ 'khor lo gcig ma/ mos gus srog 'khor gyi las tshogs/ thugs rje chen po yid bzhin 'khor lo/ gtum mo sum rtsegs/ gsang bdag 'gro bzang snying po/ 'phags pa 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs rnams mdzad/ bzhengs nas phyag mchod gang 'grub yan snga dro thams cad phyed mtshams dang gsung ngag de nas gsung ngag grol nas/ tsha bzhes thog tu rje gsum ldan ma dang*/ rjes dran rnams chag med/ gung tshigs la rjes dran dang gro gtor/ gcod kyi gung thun dgong mo'i skabs su gcod thun/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rgyun gtor cha bcu/ dgung la skang gtor sogs 'phrin las bshar bskangs tshang ma/ de'i rjes su gshin rje'i bsrung zlog sher snying gi bzlog pa/ seng gdong ma'i bsrung bzlog mtshan brjod dang mdo phran phal gzungs rnams grub rjes/ slar yang phyag mchod/ srod la gcod thun tha ma dang*/ ye shes mgon po'i 'khor lo lnga ma'i khrid rim dang*/ 'od gsal 'dzin pa bar ma/ gzims mal gyi dmigs pa sogs nyin zhag phrugs gcig la chag med du mdzad/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi bco lnga la brgya phyag 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i rtogs pa las byung ba'i theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong*/ sems bskyed len pa/ sngags la rigs lnga sdom bzung dang de'i nyin sman bla'i mdo chog 'jam sdud smon gsum bzlas/ yar ngo'i tshes bcu la 'khor lo sdom pa drug cu rtsa gnyis ma/

mar ngo'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gnyis ma/ nyer dgu la dgu gtor gsol 'debs rin chen sgrol ma tshang ba rnams la sgar pa'i phebs bzhud/ gzhan yang thugs brel che chung ci byung yang*/ skad cig kyang chag ma myong ste/ 'di yang ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar rmad du byung ba ste/ 'di dag gi bar skabs thams cad du yang*/ dbyar chos dang dgun chos dpyid chos rnams su dge 'dun brgya stong las mi nyung ba'i gtso bo sgrub sde thar pa'i gru bo che'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rtogs pa dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ bslab gsum gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i 'khor rnam bzhi rnams dang*/ gzhan yang yul mtha' bzhi'i rgyal po chen po rnams dang*/ rgyal phran chen por gtogs pa'i skyes bu gzhon nu mang po 'khor brgya stong dang bcas pa mang po dang*/ mnga' ris kyi rgyal khams 'dir che zhing btsun par grags pa'i che dgu thams cad dang*/ khyad par sngar nas 'brel tshul gyis dpal ldan 'brug pa'i gdan sa che chung gi zhal ngo rnams dang*/ stag lung pa'i mkhan slob chos gsum/ dpal ldan karma pa'i gu shrī chen po rnams dang*/ si tu ba chen po rnams dang*/ lo dang bya yul 'chad ka sogs kyi spyan snga chen po rnams dang bcas te yon tan gyi khur gyis lci ba'i ka bcu rab 'byams su grags pa mang po yang zhabs spyi bor blangs shing gdams pa drod thob nas/ dam pa 'di nyid dang ma mjal bar skyes pa don med do zhes gleng ba sha stag du byung ste/ 'chad nyan la skad cig kyang mi g.yel ba ni thugs kyi dam bca' chen po yin no// gzhan yang chos 'dod kyi skyes bu tshe 'di blos btang rnams la lhag par yang brtse bar bskyangs shing mchog gis bla mar mdzad pa kho na byung ste sa steng 'di khyab par gyur to// de ltar chu bo chen po'i rgyun ltar zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod char bzhin du bab pa'i dngos po chung ngu tsam yang chud mi zos par mdzad cing snying po len pa'i phyir du lo re bzhin ma chag par gong ma'i dus mchod chen po rnams dang*/

dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur rgya chen po dang*/ rten gsum rnam dag gi drung du tshe 'bar dang mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang mnyam pa'i mchod sprin dang*/ skye bo'i tshogs la'ang sbyin gtong gi rim pa dang*/ gzhan yang dbyar dgun gyi cha la sher phyin/ rgyas pa 'bum brgya tshar gnyis gsum las mi nyung ba dang*/ bka' 'gyur tshar lnga re/ bstan 'gyur tshar re sgrog par mdzad cing*/ ye shes mgon po gsar rnying gi bskang ba ni rgyun 'dzin bcu phrag las mi nyung ba dang*/ gsung rab kyi rgyun 'dzin bcu phrag las mi nyung ba dang*/ dpyid kyi dus su tsha tsha 'bum ther grangs mang*/ mdo rgyud nas bshad pa'i mdos rigs grangs mang rdzong ba/ spong ba'i brtul zhugs la bzhugs pa'i lo gsum phyogs gsum pa grangs mang gis cha rkyen 'bad med du sgrub pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas dngos po cung zad tsam kyang chud zos med par dkon mchog gsum gyi phyogs su thabs tshul du ma'i sgo nas gtong bar byed pa'i dam bca' chen po bzhes shing*/ gzhan dag gtong ba la mi mos pa dag kyang thabs kyis sbyin gtong dang*/ dkar phyogs la gzhol bar mdzad nas thar pa'i sa bon 'jog pa kho na'o// 'dir smras pa/ chos sku mnyam nyid dbyings las ma g.yos par// gzugs sku sgyu ma'i rnam rol cir yang ston// rgyal ba'i mdun du rgyal sras li tsa bī// 'phags yul thub pa'i zhal skyin klu sgrub mgon// rtsod dus gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rin chen dpal// da lta'i dus 'dir kun dga' rin chen zhes// grags pa'i mtshan can sa gsum 'gro ba'i mgon// rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal ba'i mdzad pa can// sems can mos pa'i khyad par sna tshogs la// phrin las rnam bzhis bskal par cho 'phrul bstan// mdzangs pa rnams kyi ser sna'i mdud pa bkrol// zhe sdang can rnams byams pa'i zil gyis mnan// nga rgyal can rnams ri bo gting nas snyil// 'dod chags can rnams tshul khrims ra bar btsud// gti mug can la rgyu 'bras me long bstan// phrag dog can rnams mnyam nyid don la bkod// snying pa med pa'i longs spyod can rnams kyang*// thabs mkhas thugs rjes tshogs gnyis gter du sbas// mi mjed zhing na ston pa gcig pu nyid// zhing khams kun na rnam 'phrul grangs med rnams// rdul phran re re'i steng du rgyal ba'i sku// longs sprul la sogs sna tshogs snang bar mdzad/

/sems can bsam pa'i khyad par ji bzhin du// gang la gang 'dul de la de ston pa'i// rnam 'phrul de snyed snang bar mdzad pa po// deng sang phyogs 'dir rnam 'phrul bstan pa ni/ /kun mthun kun las lhag par thugs rje yis// 'gro yid dga' dang mchog dga'i dpal mchog ni// mi zad mi zad rin chen gter gyi mchog /dpal ldan dpal 'byor bzang po stsol mdzad pa// 'di nyid ngo mtshar bstan pa'i rgyan du che// zhes smras so// 'di ltar bdag gi bla ma khams gsum gyi mgon po/ dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi rgyal tshab tu gyur pa/ skye dgu thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal las skyob par byed pa'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i pha mthar son pa 'dis/ tshogs gnyis rin po che'i chu gter gyis ngoms pa med pa'i brtul zhugs bzung nas/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi nyer 'tsho'i gzhi chen por gnas so// de'i dus de yi tshe na/ mnyam med dbang rin po che de nyid kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba la rlabs po che ni mdzad/ chos dang phrin las kyi sgo mtha' dag ni rje rin po che 'di la gtad cing*/ sku des 'dul ba'i gdul bya rnams yongs su rdzogs nas/ shing pho byi ba hor zla drug pa'i tshes gnyis la dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su bsdus pa las/ rin po che 'di nyid kyis mchog gi bla mar mdzad pas/ phyi nang gi mchod sprin dgongs rdzogs kyi khyad par/ gong ma'i bka' srol ji lta ba bzhin gyi rim pa gangs dkar ti se phyin gyi rim pa rnams khyad par du 'phags par bsgrubs shing*/ phyi nang gi rten gsum gyi rim pa rnams kyang bsgrubs nas/ de ka'i mod la 'jig rten gsum gyi bla ma 'di nyid kyis sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa bslu ba med par mngon du gyur pa'i mthu dang stobs phrin las gyi sgo tshan po che dri ma med pa'i stobs dang ldan pa'i mi dbang mgon po rgyal mtshan gyis zhabs 'phrin rnams bsgrubs nas/

dngos por gyur pa thams cad tshogs gnyis rin po che'i gter du sba bar mdzad pa dang*/ 'gro ba kun gyi dmigs rten dam par gyur pa/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog rnams mthing shog dri ma med pa'i ngos la rin po che gser dngul gan mas 'bur du bkod pa yig mkhan mkhas pa bzhi brgyas zla ba gsum gyi nang du glegs shing glegs thag dang bcas pa/ tog dkar ba mkhas pa bkra shis dpal ldan gyis thog drangs pa'i tog dkar gyi rig byed mkhas pa phul phyin rnams kyis legs par grub pa nas/ bslab gsum dri ma med cing yig rigs du ma'i pha mthar son pa rnams kyis zhus dag dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams kyis mdo sngags las byung ba'i rab gnas kyis byin chags par mdzad nas/ rig byed pa rnams la yang*/ dngos po bzang la khyad par du 'phags pa dag gis yon rdzongs kyis so so'i yid kyi shing rta gang nas thams cad kyis rje nyid kyi bsngags pa'i shis brjod 'ba' zhig la kha 'don du bgyid par gyur te/ re re nas yi ge'i 'du byed bsgyur mi nus so// de lta bur gegs dang bar chad med par myur du grub pa ni/ rje rin po che nyid kyis thugs rjer nges so zhes thams cad kyis mthun par mngon par gleng ngo*// gzhan yang de dag gi skabs skabs su yang*/ dpal ye shes mgon po'i rgyud bcu bdun/ bde mchog gi rgyud gnyis dang*/ mgon po mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud dang nyi shu po la glegs bam chen po gcig tu bgyis pa/ dpal mgon po'i skur rags bskor phyi nang sogs la glegs bam gcig rnams kyang rgya shog la gser dngul dang mas bri bar gnang ba dang*/ dpal mgon po'i bskang yig bstod 'bum sogs rnams kyang grangs mang du bzhengs pa/ gzhan yang rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor du ma dang*/ zhing bkod/ skyes rabs sogs gzhal du med pa lo re rer bzhengs pa la yang mtha' mi mngon no// khyad par dpal mgon po'i rnga 'chams kyi 'grig gis phyag bzhes bgyis pa/

sngar gong du rdo rje phur pa'i skor gling 'dir dar bar yod 'dug kyang*/ bar skabs su mi snang ba las/ rje 'di nyid kyi zhal bkod kyis rim pas phur pa'i rtsa 'chams cha lag dang bcas pa de ka'i chos skor gser rnga grangs mang*/ gser rgyan ngo mtshar ba re re la'ang dar sna lnga lnga'i cod paṇa tshang ba mgo brnyan gyi bye brag mang po/ khyad par bka' srung chen mo'i zhal 'bag ye shes pa bzhugs ngo shes pa la/ rje nyid kyis bka' bsgo lan grangs mang du mdzad pa la 'cham gos phyag mtshan dang sbrags pa/ dpal mgon po'i 'phyar dar g.yul rgyal mar grags pa sde gzar chen mo'i dus/ gong ma'i dmag byung dus bzhengs ma thag dpung rang sor byer bar gyur nas mtshan g.yul rgyal chen por gsol bas thog drangs 'phyar dar che chung brgya lhag bzhengs par gyur to// de lta bu'i bdag nyid chen po 'dis/ bka' 'gyur rin po che bzhengs su gsol ba nas/ bstan 'gyur rin po che bzhengs kyi bar du'ang*/ dge 'dun gyi sde 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu bri ba dang gang ba mi mngon pa'i 'dus pa la lugs gnyis kyis bskyangs shing*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gdugs thogs pa du ma yang rang rang gi yul dang gdul byar rdzogs pa'i bkod pa yang nyi ma re re bzhin mdzad pa yang blo las 'das so// 'dir smras pa/ rgyal dang rgyal sras sems dpa' che rnams kyis// 'dren mchog gtso bo rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen// mkhyen gnyis mi zad mkha' ltar khyab pa po// phrin las srid mthar ston pa bcom ldan 'das// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang khyod nyid ni// bdag cag dpal du shar bas e ma mtshar// mthong thos dran dang reg dang 'brel gyur rnams// thams cad ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las bral gyur zhing*// 'gro kun dge la bkod mdzad chos kyi rje// 'di 'dra'i mgon gyis rjes bzung bskal pa bzang*// de phyir snying na bdag cag gsol ba 'debs// de ltar bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid dpal 'bri gung byung chub kyi gling gi zhing gi bkod par bzhugs nas/

lha mi'i dpal 'byor thams cad dbyar sprin bzhin du 'dus pa ni/ rgya'i gong ma rnam gsum gyi 'bul ba/ mnga' ris skor gsum gyi 'bul ba/ gu ge dang ya rtse sogs rgya chen po/ mdo khams skor gsum sogs 'dan yul gyi grwa bskor/ ru bzhi dbus kyi grwa sde so so nas 'bul ba'i bye brag dpag med rnams chud mi za bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ 'gro ba mtha' dag rnams thar pa'i lam la 'god pa'i phyir/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab la rgyal ba nyid dang mtshungs par rgya che ba'i don rnams la/ thogs pa med pa'i blo gros kyi snang ba phyin ci ma log par gsal ba rgyal ba nyid dang mtshungs pa dag gis zab mo'i don 'grel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos/ lo paṇa chen po rnams kyis ji snyed 'gyur ba rnams ni/ shes bya'i gnas mtha' dag mngon sum du gzigs pa'i mig ltar mtshungs par gzigs nas/ 'di dag 'bru dag par glegs bam dkar por bkod pa sngon chad bod 'dir mang bar byung 'dug kyang*/ glegs bam sngon po po ti la bzhengs pa mi 'dug nas/ rje rin po che nyid kyis rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la sngon chad ma byung ba'i bkur sti chen pos bsnyen bkur ba dang*/ bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs po che sgrub par bzhed nas/ thugs dam bstan 'gyur rin po che bka' brgyud gong ma'i bka' 'bum gtos che ba dang bcas pa glegs bam sngon po'i mdzes rgyan 'di nyid bzhengs pa'i phyi mo ni/ 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs dam bstan 'gyur dkar po las byas shing*/ dag pa'i chu rgyun gyi byi dor dang cung zad kha 'thor ba rnams legs par bsdus ste tshang bar mdzad nas/ sde tshan so so'i bzhugs tshul go rim rnams mkhas grub dam pa rnams kyis dkar chag gzhir bzhag nas/ gang zhig mkhas par rloms pa dag gi rang bzos bris pa rnams ngal gso'i gnas su mdzad nas bzhengs pa ni/ mkha' lding gi rgyal po bya'i lo la/ 'phan 'og gi bris mkhan mkhas shing mkhas pa'i dbang po grangs mang bsdus nas legs par bzhengs su gsol ba'i bkod pa dang thugs khur gyi khyad par thams cad ni/

nye gnas chen po mi dbang mgon po rgyal mtshan rang gis mdzad cing*/ rje rin po che nyid kyis ji ltar bka' bkod pa ltar/ rgyu bzang la dngos dag pa dang ldan pa/ mthing shog sngon po dri ma med pa la/ rin po che gser dngul dag mas legs par bris pa glegs bam gnyis gnyis bsdoms pa'i brgya dang brgyad so sor byas na nyis brgya dang bcu drug 'byung ba de dag lo khongs bzhi la grub pa'i zhu dag pa ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sgra dang yig bris la mkhas pa mang po dang gling rin po che rang du bzhugs pa'i klog mkhan phul du phyin pa rnams kyis lan du mar zhu dag byas te/ 'gro ba'i mchod sdong chen por rab tu gnas par bya ba'i rim pa ni/ sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po zla 'od pa'i zhal mnga' nas kyi gtso bor bzhugs shing dge 'dun grangs tshang gis rgyud sde las byung ba'i rab gnas kyis byin chags par mdzad cing*/ de'i dus su rje nyid kyis gtso mdzad snam sbyar gyi rgyal mtshan thogs pa'i dge slong mang pos me tog 'thor ba'i dus su/ nam mkha' nas kyang lha yis me tog sna tshogs 'thor ba dang*/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur la sogs pa'i bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang ldan par gyur to// smras pa/ rgyal ba gnyis pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyis// zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i sa// drang srong chen po bsam gtan sgrub pa'i gnas// rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang pos// dri med chos 'khor bskor zhing bzhugs pa'i gnas// skal ldan chos 'dod tshogs rnams 'du ba'i zhing*// mtshe'u kha bde chen gtsug lag khang chen du// rjai 'dis bzhengs pa'i rten gsum mang po dang*// bka' 'gyur la sogs ji snyed bzhugs gyur cing*// khyad par phyogs 'dir sngon chad ma byung ba'i// bstan 'gyur rin chen bstan pa'i rgyan mdzes 'di// rin chen bum bzang 'dod dgu'i yid bzhin nor// ma lus gcig bsdus zhing 'dir spungs pa bzhin// rnam mang 'gro la tshogs gnyis spel ba'i phyir// mtshungs med rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis// rin chen rin thang med pa 'di bstsal nas// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za'i tshogs rnams dang*// rang rang legs par spyod cing mchod par bgyis// nyan bshad klog dang sems shing bsgom pa sogs// chos spyod rnam bcu 'phel ba'i gzhir gyur cig

/dal 'byor rin chen snying po len 'dod rnams// gus pa'i yid kyis 'dud na don chen 'grub// mthong thos dran rig zas nor longs spyod rnams// phyogs 'dir lus ngag bgyi ba gang bgyis pa// thar pa'i lam sna zin par the tshom med// de phyir dga' bar bgyis la gsol ba thob// ces smras so// de ka'i bar skabs su/ skye dgu rnams skal pa dman pa'i dbang gis/ rgyal khams 'khrugs pa chen po langs te/ phal cher sne gdong pa dang*/ rin spungs pa dang dpon blon tsha zhang nang 'khrug byung bas/ sne gdong pa spangs mtho ba byung ba'i thugs rgyal gyis/ 'bri gung pa'ang mnga' 'og tu 'jug pa'i blos/ sngar 'bri gdan gyi dam tshig las 'gongs nas/ dpung gis kyang 'jigs 'jigs ltar ston pa dang*/ gser yig khra chen mang po'i bkod pa byung nas/ thams cad kyi mya ngan gyi khang bur zhugs nas ci bya gtol med du gnas pa la/ rje 'di nyid thugs mnyam pa nyid las mi g.yo ba'i ngang nas snying rje chen pos nye bar btul nas/ thams cad kyang rang gnas su/ sprin phung 'thor rlung gis bdas pa ltar yal bar gyur nas/ zhabs la 'ga' zhig gis btud pa la/ rje btsun nyid kyis gsung ngag bden pas bkrol nas/ 'bri gdan mtshams sngar lugs 'di bzhin yin tshul/ skyob pa nyid kyis dpal kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod kyi gdan sa mdzad tshul/ de'i rjes la spyan snga rin po che 'khor sum brgya dang bcas nas btang tshul/ de nas nyer gnyis rin po che yan 'bri gdan zung gcig tshul rnams dang*/ da lta'ang de mthun gyi chos dang 'jig rten gyi dgos kyi legs bshad kyis khungs rin po che'i bdud rtsi lta bus skye bo de dag gi yid tshim par mdzad cing*/ de mthun gyi dri bzhon bzang po gong ma'i snyan du gsol bas/ gong nas kyang de bzhin gyi khur bzhes nas re zhig chings tshul gyis bsring bar gyur pa las/ de mthun gyi gser yig pa rdzangs byung ba las/

'bri gung pa'i sde srid mnga' ris su gtogs pa thams cad kyis blo mthun gcig tu byas nas/ bod dbus phyogs pa thams cad kyi gong ma'i gser yig khur dus/ nga rang gis kyang blangs par grags tshul zhus pa la/ skyob pa 'di nyid kyis 'bri gdan so so'i dam tshig bsam dgos pa ni gzhir gzhag mod kyis/ de ltar ma yin par mi 'os pa'i 'jig rten lugs kyi drag zhan gyi khur mi 'khur thag chod/ nged rang skyob pa rin po che yab sras kyi rus mi 'tshong*/ cis kyang na mdo khams su 'gro ba yin mod de cang mi to/ bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ bka' dang srung ma bzang ba yin/ gsung nas gros kyi mdun sar dbugs dbyung bar mdzad nas/ rje nyid kyis kyang thugs dam brtags pas/ rma lam du/ a phyi chen mo 'di nyid mnga' bdag chen mo'i tshul du bzhugs 'dug pa la/ bdag cag gis bya ba ji ltar 'gyur zhus pas/ blo ma mang bar mnyam par zhog la bstan pa dang dkar phyogs la brtson pa ma dor dang*/ nyes par mi 'gyur ro// zhes bka' phebs pas/ thugs brling bar gyur nas/ bstan 'gyur rin po che bzhengs pa'i 'phro de ka rkyen khar ma btang bar legs par grub pas/ rang gzhan thams cad kyis ha las shing*/ ngo mtshar ba'i gtam gyis nam mkha'i lto ba khengs par gyur to// gzhan yang de'i 'phul la/ slar sne gdong pa'i dpung dang*/ 'ol kha stag zher gyi dpung dang*/ stag rtse ba dang*/ stag lung pa'i dpung la sogs pa thams cad kyis gung bsgrigs nas/ so so nas gnad du bsnun pa las/ rje rin po che 'di nyid kyis kyang 'dus pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas pa dag gis/ dkon mchog la bden gsol dang*/ chos skyong la phrin las bcol ba dang*/ mi dbang mgon po rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos kyang*/ rang gi 'khor 'bangs kyi dpung gis g.yul bshams pa'i thabs kyi sbyor ba byas pa las/ pha rol po thams cad rengs pa dang*/ brgyal ba dang*/

rmongs par gyur te/ phyogs dang phyogs thams cad du pham zhing nongs pas/ rang rang gi gnas su dengs nas rang phyogs thams cad rgyal zhing rnam par rgyal ba chen por gyur pa ni/ dper na/ lha'i dbang po lha min las g.yul rgyal ba lta bu ste/ de yang bka' srung chen mos mngon sum nyid du ni// gzim khang 'phyong rtse'i shar nas nub sgo ru// chu rta sngon po bcibs nas rngam stabs su// bya rgod thul ba gsol nas 'jigs pa yi// phyag mtshan dang ldan 'khor gyi tshogs dag ni// 'bum phrag dang bcas glog 'gyu'i tshul du gshegs/ de ka'i mod la thams cad byar ba yi gtam snyan 'bul bar sleb byung bas/ der zhabs 'bring du bzhugs pa dang*/ phyogs phyogs kyi che btsun tshogs pa thams cad kyis/ rje 'di nyid mthu dang stobs kyi dbang phyug chen po padma 'byung gnas dngos su byon par nges so zhes gleng ba dang*/ gter ston padma gling pa'i lung bstan thog tu phebs pas/ 'di ni gu ru padma byung gnas kyi gsung gi sprul pa/ 'bri gung gi spyan snga bcu gsum pa snang mdzad rdo rje zhes lung bstan mngon du gyur pas/ mdor na mthu dang stobs kyi mnga' bdag bstan pa rin po che'i khur 'dzin/ 'gro ba thabs kyis 'dul ba'i ston pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i mtshan 'dzin pa 'dis/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub dam pa bla na med pa brnyes nas/ thams cad mkhyen zhing gzigs pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul du gyur pas/ sngags phyi nang gi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa nyi ma re re bzhin zhal gzigs pa dang*/ lung bstan pa dang*/ rjes su gnang ba dpag tu med pa ste/ de yang thog kha gser khang du bzhugs pa'i dus shig ni/ nyid kyi sku'i mchan g.yas g.yon nas bya rog snum la 'gril ba gnyis dngos su 'phur pa gzigs pa dang*/ yang dgun khrid dus/ mar me zhun gyis gang ba mang po sgron pa dang*/

'ga' zhig sgron rgyu sogs drod kyi rtags mang po byung ba dang*/ yi dam zhal gnyis ma 'di'i sgrub thabs rtsom par gnang dus/ rmi lam du 'jigs su rung ba'i bud med ral pa'i do shal 'phyang ba zhig gis/ bdud rtsi ril bu zhig dang*/ thod pa mtshan ldan chang gis bskang ba zhig gnang nas/ 'di skad du/ dngos grub gnyis po thob par gyur cig gzhan la yang byin cig ces gsungs nas/ nyid kyis ji ltar spyod zhes gsol ba gdab pa las/ rang gzhan kun gyis thun mong dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro// zhes mi snang bar gyur to// yang re zhig nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas kyi ya gyal ti sgro mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i tshogs khang du/ gu ru mtsho skyes kyi sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus/ gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje nyid skyes bu gzhon nu'i tshul du bstan nas/ sku las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros zhing*/ phyag mtshan gyi lcags kyu dang*/ zhags pa dang phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad pa gcig rnams phul nas/ dngos grub rnam bzhi 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes gnang ba byin par gyur to// brag khung gi gseng zhig nas dri bzang gis khyab pa zhig rgyun ldan du byung ba la gzigs pas/ phreng ba rdog po chen po dri bzang gis khyab pa zhig dngos su rnyed pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i rten 'brel sna tshogs byung*/ u rgyan rin po ches byin gyis brlabs shing*/ zhal mngon sum du gzigs zhes thos so// yang rin po che 'di nyid/ spyan snga rin po ches/ skyob pa nyid yin par lung yang yang bstan zhing gser khang chos rje'i bstod pa las kyang*/ khyod nyid khyod kyi bstan pa la// slar yang gsal byed rin chen mchog /chos kyi rgyal po kun dga'i mtshan// zhes dngos su lung bstan no// dus gcig gi tshe/ sgrub sder 'byon pa'i rmi lam du/ me tog rgya men mang po la la dag kha bye/ la la dag kha 'byed rgyur 'dug pa las/ rje nyid sku la chos gos rnam pa gsum dang ldan par mdzad cing gyen gyi phyogs su byon pa rmi lam du byung 'dug nas/

sgrub sde 'di la brten nas bstan pa 'phel rgyas chen po zhig 'byung ngo gsungs shing*/ mgon po klu sgrub tu zhal gyis bzhes pa yang yang mdzad pa'i bka' phebs so// yang spangs bzung gi gnas su/ bcom ldan 'das mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po gtso 'khor gsum zhal gzigs shing*/ rje 'di 'phags pa kun dga' bor lung bstan nas/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba rgyas pa zhig 'od zer gyi tshul du thim par gyur zhes thos so// yang byang du me nyag ja pa'i gdong la phebs dus/ nad yams kyi 'jigs pa yod 'dug nas/ drung skor rnams skrag cing dngangs pa las/ a phyi chen mo sku las 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phro ba zhig zhal gzigs nas dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga bkye ba dang*/ skyon med zhes dbugs dbyung bar mdzad do// rje nyid kyis dngos sam nyams kyis zhi khro rab 'byams bstan srung rgya mtsho zhal gzigs pa ni/ nyang po gad pa mkhar du u rgyan gyi sprul pa rnal 'byor pa zhig dang mjal nas/ phyi nang gi gdams pa mang po dngos su gnang zhing gar bzhud gtad med du song ba dang*/ phag mo na rgya lu dpal grags 'das dus gral dbu mdzad pa las sku'i bkod pa gsum bstan pa dang*/ lha khang chen mor thub pa longs sku zhal gzigs pa dang*/ gser khang du sa ra ha dang*/ klu sgrub zhal gzigs pa dang*/ mtshe'u khar sku yab snyung dus/ g.yas su bde mchog gis dbang bzhi bskur ba/ g.yon phyogs su rdo rje rnal 'byor mas brda chos bstan pa dang*/ dbyar chos dus su rgyun gtor gyi skabs su dzam lha zhal gzigs pa dang*/ rtse bar yum gyi dgongs rdzogs kyi dus su/ zhal nas bya rog gsum dngos su thon zhing*/ gcig shar phyogs la 'phur/ gnyis zhal du slar yang zhugs pa dang*/ rgyun tu dpal ye shes kyi mgon po gtso 'khor zhal gzigs shing*/ a phyi dang tshe ring ma yang dang yang du zhal gzigs nas gtor ma len pa dang*/ legs nyes kyi lung ston pa dang*/

dpal mgon po gter ma legs ldan nag po rnams zhal gzigs nas phrin las bsgrub pa/ mgon po'i rnam 'phrul khyi nag chen po dang*/ bya nag gis dngos su gtor ma len pa dang*/ de dag sku'i g.yas g.yon du gnas pa yang gzhan gyis mthong ba dang*/ yang mtshe'u khar u rgyan gyi sprul pas bsam yas zhig gsos kyi rab gnas zhus shing gnang nas gar song cha med du song zhing*/ phyis nyid kyi sprul par zhal gyis bzhes pa dang*/ ti sgro ru gu ru yab yum zhal gzigs pa/ rdo rje phag mos dngos su dbang bskur zhing bum chu blud pa/ lung bstan tsha chu sman chu kha dog gur kum lta bur gyur pa/ phyag mdzod du mgon po'i sku las me 'bar ba dang*/ phyag skyogs kyi bdud rtsi khol ba'i dris phyogs su khyab pa byung ba/ byang du gnyan chen thang lhas 'bul ba dang*/ zhabs 'bring bsgrub pa/ yang rnying mar padma tshe dpag med yab yum dang*/ beng chos gos gsol ba dang*/ phyag na rdo rje u tsarya me dpung nang du bzhugs pa zhal gzigs zhing*/ sku'i bar chad bsal ba/ rje nyid dpal mgon po'i skur bzhengs nas gar mang po mdzad pa sogs mgon po 'di nyid dang dbyer med kyi sgo nas phrin las bzhi la dbang bsgyur ba ni mngon sum du gyur pa kho na'o// gzhan yang rje 'di nyid la dad pas gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dad ldan gyi skyes bu rnams la gzhan rkyen gyi nad sel ba dang*/ sdug bsngal las skyob par mdzad cing grol bar gyur pa mang po dag la mthong snang sna tshogs byung ba dang*/ 'chi kha ma la'ang dngos su byon nas ngo sprod dang gsal 'debs gnang ba sogs gang 'dul gyi skur bstan pa ni dpag tu med do// 'dir smras pa/ khyab bdag 'di nyid dus gsum rgyal ba dang*// zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor thams cad la// dbang bsgyur rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa' dngos// rigs brgya'i bzlos gar 'gro ba'i don nyid la// sgyu ma'i gar 'di sna tshogs thabs kyis ston// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso// thams cad mkhyen pa mgon po kun dga'i mtshan// gang de'i zhabs kyi pad mo dri med pa// spyi bo'i gtsug tu rtag tu mchod par bgyis// gzhan yang dam pa 'dis thugs bskyed dang gtong phod kyi khyad par re res kyang*/

skye dgu thams cad kyi mig 'dren pa dang*/ nyer 'tsho'i gzhi chen por mdzad pa'i tshul yang*/ glang gi lor lcam dang*/ stag gi lo la gcen po rnam par rgyal ba'i mtshan can/ sku'i dkyil 'khor dag pa'i dbyings su thim pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi bye brag cha rkyen rnams phangs med du gnang ba dang*/ zhal lta bkod pa'i khyad par 'bad med du sgrub pa'i don gyi smon lam rgya mtsho spel ba'i phyir/ jo gdan chos lung tshogs pa chen mo spyan drangs shing*/ bsnyen bkur rgya chen pos bsnyen bkur mdzad pa sogs ni brir mi lang shing*/ spre'u yi lo la yum drung chen mo zhi bar gshegs pa'i bye brag tu/ sa chen po 'di yi steng na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral bar mdzad cing smon lam rgya mtsho'i don la dbang bsgyur ba'i phyir/ stag lung nas chos kyi rje rnam rgyal grags pa dpal bzang po'i mtshan can spyan drangs nas/ zhabs tog bsnyen bkur rgya chen pos mnyes par mdzad cing*/ 'bri stag gi sde ris kyang chos bzhin du skyong ba dang*/ bka' brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i khur bzhes kyi bgro ba bla na med pa mdzad do// de ka'i phyi ma bya lo la/ gcung po chos kyi rgyal po sprul pa'i gnas su thim pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyang nyid kyis bsgrubs pa'i tshul grangs las 'das par mdzad nas gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa rlabs po che kho nas sgrub brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel bar skad cig kyang g.yel bar mi mnga' zhing*/ phrin las sgo mtha' yas pa ni yi ge'i 'du byed bsgyur bar mi nus shing*/ de lta bas na rje btsun rin po che 'di nyid kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen la mchod pa dang bkur sti dang rim gro bgyid pa la ngoms pa med par gyur pas/ slar bde chen yangs pa can du/ sgar chen phebs pa'i lam/ stag lung nas phyogs te phebs shing*/ stag lung chos rje sku mched hor khang ba dang mkhan slob chos gsum gyis gtso mdzad/

dge 'dun thams cad kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen po bsgrubs shing*/ 'bab rom sgom khyung sbra kha sogs thams cad kyis/ dngos po dpag tu med pa'i bkur sti rim gro bla na med pas/ dngos po'i sum cha phyag tu btang nas/ sku'i dkyil 'khor blta ba dang*/ gsung gi bdud rtsi dri ma med pas bskyangs nas/ thams cad la thar pa'i sa bon 'jog par mdzad cing*/ bde chen yangs pa can du rin po che rnam gnyis mjal 'phrad dang*/ chos kyi sgro 'dogs chod par mdzad nas lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas phrin las mi zad pa'i 'khor los 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du sems can rnams smin grol la bkod pa'i thugs bskyed chen mo bzhes nas/ slar 'bri gung 'og min gyi gnas kyi gtsug lag khang du gdan phebs nas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che lugs gnyis kyi gtsug lag khrims gnyis gser gyi gnya' shing 'dzin par mdzad nas/ sgrub brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad do// smras pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan gsang ba'i gnad// mi zad rgyan dang ldan pa bcom ldan 'das// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang dkyil 'khor gtso// rigs brgya'i bdag po rgyal dbang kun dga'i mtshan// snyigs dus 'dren pa thams cad mkhyen par 'dud// 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba bla na med pa mngon du gyur pa'i ye shes chen pos gdul bya'i rgyud la 'jug pa'i phyir/ sems can de dang de dag gi mos pa'i dbang gis khams dang bag la nyal gyis mos pa la dgongs nas sprul pa dang bsgyur ba sna tshogs kyi re ba bskang bar gyur nas/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bur dbang mdzad par gyur nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa brnyes nas/ mi las 'das pa'i rdzas dang yo byad sna tshogs kyi longs spyod char bzhin du bab pas/ de dag la snying po len pa'i phyir du/

rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyi bka' srol bla na med par skyong zhing rgyas par mdzad cing*/ thugs bskyed rin po che ji ltar bzhes pa de dag mngon du gyur pa'i tshul skyob pa rin po che nyid kyis thugs bzhed kyis/ dpal gyi bkra shis sgo mang bzhengs pa'i thugs 'dun mdzad ma thag sngon gyi smon lam dang thugs rje las grub pa rnams kyis ji ltar bzhed pa'i dngos po de dang de dag ched du bskul ba bzhin zhabs drung du dngos dang brgyud kyi gter bzhin du spungs par gyur pa la/ bdag cag gi bla ma ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i sems can gyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen chen po 'jig rten gsum gyi bla ma/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po zhes snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po sa gsum du g.yo ba can/ de'i mkhyen pa'i chu gter chen pos 'gro kun srid pa'i rgya mtsho chen po las sgrol bar byed pa'i gnyen gcig pu de nyid kyis/ mi mjed kyi zhing 'dir sngon chad ma byung zhing*/ phyis kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba'i rten gyi mchog chen po/ ye shes rnam grol gyi mdangs bkra zhing sku lnga'i zer 'phro bas 'jig rten thams cad bkram pas/ lus can bla na med pa'i byang chub la bkod par bya ba'i phyir/ bkra shis sgo mang yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che bzhengs pa'i rgyu yi khyad par lha dang mi'i rin po che mtha' dag kha phye nas/ 'og tu rin po che'i sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lte bar lhun sdug cing byin chags pa'i mchod sdong khyad 'phags drug dang ldan pa bzhengs su gsol ba ni/ sngar smos pa ltar/ skyob pa nyid kyis thugs ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo las/ sgam po gdar ri'i rtse nas dpal dag pa shel gyi ri bo la nyis stong dang brgyad brgya mchod rten bang rim mchod sdong dang bcas pa mkha' 'gro mas rta rnga'i drwa mig la gdan drangs nas gzigs phul zhing*/

de nyid dper byas nas/ mchod rten brgyad las bkra shis sgo mang gi rnam pa de las khyad du 'phags pa'i bang rim can 'di nyid bzhengs pa ni/ dpal kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod dang*/ 'bri gung byang chub kyi gling du bzhugs pa las/ gdung rgyud rim pas bzhengs pa 'ga' zhig ni dus kyi dbang gis chud zos shing*/ bcu gnyis rin po che dang*/ nyer brgyad pa dang*/ nyer gnyis pa'i thugs dam sgo mang sogs las dpe blangs pa las/ de rnams gang las kyang rgya khyon dpag tshad ches cher che ba/ rgyu yi khyad par yang shin tu bzang zhing rgya che ba dang bcas pa 'di nyid/ rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas shing*/ bla ma rin po che brgyud pa dang bcas pa/ khyad par mnyam med dbang ratna'i mtshan can gyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang*/ sku drin gsob pa'i phyir du/ thog mar lha'i bzo bo bi shwa karma'i lag rtsed la 'gran par nus pa/ deng sang rgya dkar nag bal po sogs thams cad du bzo rigs las 'gran pa'i zla thams cad bral ba/ dpon mo che rdo rje zhes bya ba rgyal ba'i dbang po karma pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i lha bzo chen mo de nyid dpon g.yog sum cu spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya ba btang nas/ yun ring zhig lon pa las thams cad kyis mi 'byon pa yin nam zhes gleng ba na/ rje nyid kyi rmi lam du/ dpal mgon po mi'u thung dkar po beng shing bsnams pa zhig gis mtshe'u kha'i sgo drung nas dpon mo che pa rnams myur du 'byor bar yod do// zhes brda sbyar nas mi snang bar gyur to// de nas 'phral du slob dpon padmas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas sbas lung jo bo be ga'i bzhugs gnas nas rig byed dang nye ba'i rig byed la mkhas pa'i skyes bus gang ba'i sa phyogs byar zhes bya ba nas myur du phebs nas/ me mo sbrul gyi lo zla ba bcu pa'i nyin par gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po dang ldan pa la/ mtshungs med chos kyi rje rin po che 'di nyid dpon slob drung skor ba rnams sprul sku chen po nyid dang bcas te sgo mang du phebs te gzigs rtog dang dpe blangs sogs zhal bkod rnams mdzad pa na/

mtshe'u kha dang 'bri gung mthil gyi bar thams cad 'ja' tshon sna lngas 'brel ba dang*/ me tog gi char sna tshogs bab pa sogs thams cad kyis ya mtshan du byed pa byung zhing*/ ri bo'i ngos thams cad kyang mtshon ris shin tu bkra ba'i 'ja' tshon gyis yol ba bris pa lta bur gyur pa sogs ngo mtshar zhing dge mtshan du mas skye dgu rnams kyi yid tshim par mdzad nas phyag tshad rnams kyang legs par blangs nas/ de dag las kyang khyad par 'phags pa drug dang ldan par byas nas/ khyad par bka' brgyud bla ma'i bang rim spar nas bzo khyad bla na med pa drug bstan pa'i sgo nas/ grub chen brgyad cu nas chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po gter mgon gyi bar lha grangs sum brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gcig 'phar ba'i zhal bkod kyi khyad par rnams kyis khyab par mdzad de/ zla ba de nyid kyi nyer gnyis la lha khang chen mor bzo thab btsugs nas/ byin gyis rlabs pa chen pos byin gyis brlabs par mdzad nas/ de'i dus thams cad du 'ja' 'od kyi gur nyin mtshan thams cad du phub cing*/ me tog gi char chen po yang babs/ than pa'i dus yin pa la/ dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i klu rnams kyis char gyi rgyun ha cang che ba yang ma yin/ chung ba yang ma yin par bab pas/ sa gzhi rtsi shing dang nags tshal rtsi thog dang bcas pa 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur to// rgyu rab tu gnas pa mdzad pa'i dus/ ltas dang cho 'phrul bzang po ni/ 'brug sgra chen pos phyogs thams cad khyab pa dang*/ gzhan yang ltas dang cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa dang*/ dpal mgon po beng lcam dral dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis bar chad bsal ba'i rtags dang bzo rig pa rnams kyis sems la dang ba'i me tog gsar pa 'khrungs par gyur cing*/ dpon mo che ba'i rmi lam du yang rje rin po che 'di nyid sku la chos gos rnam pa gsum dang ldan pa nam mkha' la 'phags shing lha'i bu dang bu mo dpag tu med pas bskor nas mtshe'u kha dang lha khang gi thang thams cad 'phreng ma chad par 'brel ba dang ltas dang nye ba'i ltas bzang po dag byung zhes gsung ngo*// rje rin po che nyid kyi rmi lam du bka' srung chen mo 'di nyid mched lnga dang*/

tshe ring mched lnga sogs kyis lha yi na bza' dang*/ rin po che gser g.yus brgyan pa mang pos bkra shis brjod pa dang*/ deng nas mngon du ma gyur bar bsrung ngo*// zhes dam bcas shing khas blang bar gyur to// de lta bas na bzo rig pa rnams kyang ltas bzang pos bskul te/ dad pa las kyang ches dad nas nyin mtshan g.yel ba med par rin po che nyid la gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ bzo'i khyad par la spro ba dang ldan pas sgrub cing yid gzhung pa dang ldan par gyur nas/ rje nyid kyi dgongs pa bsgrub pa la phan tshun 'gran pa lta bu las thams cad kyis yid 'phrog par mdzad do// de'i dus su rig byed pa rnams kyis zhabs tog bsnyen bkur dus bzhi dang bstun pa'i sgo nas bza' ba dang*/ de'i bca' ba myang ba la sogs pa yul mi gcig pa'i lugs kyi rang rang gi yid la ji ltar bab pa rnams phongs pa med par mdzad cing*/ gzhan yang gos dang mal stan sogs kyang*/ dbyar dgun sogs dus bzhi dang bstun pa'i sgo nas/ thugs brtse bar bskyangs shing skyo ngal med par mdzad de/ de dag re re bzhin gang dgos pa'i bran g.yog kyang gang la gang dgos thogs pa med par bskos nas/ rang rang la ci dgos kyi 'dod yon bstabs pas/ rang yul kyang brjed pa ltar bsgrubs shing*/ zla ba re re bzhin du yang dus bstun gyi rim pa dang de'i gnang sbyin gos dar/ ja/ rta/ drel/ gser g.yu la sogs pas rang gi yid kyi shing rta gang bar gyur pas/ skye bo phal mo che'i blor mi shong ba dang*/ khyad par dus chen rnams la/ nyid kyi rigs dang chos las 'khrungs pa'i dbon rigs chen po skyes mchog des kyang gnang sbyin gyi bye brag rgya chen po dang*/ gnyer las 'dzin so so nas rin po ches gtso mdzad kyis/ ston mo che chung gi bye brag bzang zhing gya nom pa/ bu chen dang slob ma rnams dang*/ drung skor rnams dang yul so sor bskos pa'i dpon che chung*/

byang bod kyi sde dpon dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang*/ rnam thos kyi bu la 'gran nus pa'i ka ru ma bzang po dang bcas pa'i sgo nas/ rig byed pa rnams kyang gya nom pa'i dngos po bzang zhing rgya che ba'i bsnyen bkur phan tshun 'gran pa ltar mtha' yas pas dkar po'i sa bon 'debs par byas so// de lta bu'i rten bzhengs kyi grags pa'i dri bzhon gyis sa gsum du rnam par grags pas khyab par gyur pas rgya nag gong ma'i gnang sbyin sogs mdor na 'jig rten na mngon par mtho ba dag gis/ dngos po rin thang can du mas/ 'bul snod thams cad bkang nas mngon par phul nas/ rin po che'i bang mdzod khengs par mdzad do// dpal thams cad mkhyen pa karma pa zhwa nag cod pan 'dzin pa brgyad pas kyang ring nas bsngags pa dang gser zangs dpag tu med pa'i skyes dang*/ dpal chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang pos kyang*/ legs tshogs mngon par bstod nas/ rin po che rin thang med pa'i bye brag gi dngos po grangs med pa'i gnang cha dang*/ gzhan yang dbus gtsang gi btsad po rnams dang*/ gzhis kha rin spungs pas kyang dngos po ji snyed pa gang la gang 'tsham dus dang sbyar nas 'bul bkod dang*/ dpal stag lung pa grwa nang mnga' ris skor gsum gyis 'bul ba/ gnas chen tsā ri dang*/ nyang kong rnye rngod khams ri bo che sogs phyogs mtshams med pa thams cad nas 'dod dgu'i longs spyod 'bab chu chen po'i rgyun ltar zad mi shes pas dam pa 'di'i dgongs pa mthar phyin pa'i mthun rkyen rnams phyogs tha dad nas dad cing dang ba'i sgo nas lhur blangs pas/ tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen po'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par rol pa chen po'o// dam pa 'di nyid ni thugs rje bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas yin pas/ sngon chad sangs rgyas kyi phrin las ma zhugs pa'i hor nag pos kyang*/ dngos po rgya chen pos zhabs 'bring dang*/ bka' nyan par gyur nas/

bkra shis sgo mang lha mi kun gyi mchod gnas 'di nyid kyi bsngags pa brjod pa sha stag go// de ltar lha klu gnod sbyin mi dang mi ma yin pa dngos grub rin po che'i 'byung gnas chen po'i gter ltar gyur pa nas/ de dag gi rgyu phun sum tshogs pa'i che ba brjod nas/ dang po bzo phud ni mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud ces grags pa'i 'od zer gyi phreng bas nam mkha'i mthar gtugs pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gi sgron mer gyur pa'i bla ma de nyid/ mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po la sogs pa mdo rgyud du ma nas lung bstan pa ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa byang phyogs su rgyas par mdzad pa'i mnyam med zla 'od gzhon nu 'di nyid la/ rje nyid kyis mi phyed pa'i dad pas zhal yang yang mjal zhing lung bstan thob pas/ de'i rten 'brel gyi che bas rgyu rin po che sha stag la zhal bkod kyis khyab par mdzad nas/ dpon chen pos kyang bzo khyad kyi khyad par gyis thon par byas nas dbyar chos dus grub pa la/ nang bzhugs sogs ngo mtshar bar byas nas/ rab tu gnas pa ni skyob pa rin po che'i phyag bzhes kyis byang chub lngar bsgyur zhing sku bzhir sgrub pa'i rim par gnang nas/ me tog 'thor ba'i dus su yang*/ spos kyi dri sna tshogs pa dang*/ me tog gi char dbab pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas shing*/ der gnas pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po snam sbyar thogs pa mang po'i gtso bo rje nyid rang gis mdzad cing shis pa brjod nas byin chags par mdzad nas mos gus kyi dran pa gsal bar byed du bzhugs so// dpal bkra shis sgo mang gi lha lugs su blugs pa dang*/ 'phrul las grub pa sogs re re la'ang bzhugs tshul phyag mtshan rnam 'gyur dang bcas pa skyob pa nyid kyis nga'i rten bkra shis sgo mang gi lha re res kyang phrin las bzhi dang sku bzhi ye shes lnga grub chen brgyad sogs 'grub pas/

lha che chung gang yang de dang de dag gi gzhung nas bshad pa'i phyag tshad sogs thams cad kyang mdo rgyud nas bshad pa ltar/ gtso che ba de thig tshad rnam gzhag dang mi 'gal ba zhig gal che bas/ de las legs pa'i zhal gzigs zer ba'i mdo rgyud nas bshad pa dang 'gal bas ni phan yon mi 'byung gsungs pas na/ mdo rgyud nas bshad pa ltar dus gsum rgyal ba'i mchod sdong ratna tsarya'i mchod rten chen po 'di la yang lha re re bzhin zhal bkod kyis khyab par gnang nas grub pa sha stag ste/ de yang lugs ma'i gtso bo byang chub kyi mchod sdong chen po dbu rtse nyi zla bya ru dang bcas pa la bzhugs pa'i chos rje bla ma'i dngul sku chen po dngul srang sum cu las legs par grub pa/ phyag tshad dang skye mched sogs legs par grub pa/ khri rgyab yol zangs gser las grub pa/ bkra shis pa'i khri drug 'gyogs/ rgyan rnam bzhi dang bcas pa la rin po che'i phras brgyan pa/ dpon mo che pas bzo gnyer bzung tsam las rang byon gyi tshul du byung bas/ dpon mo che ba dpon g.yog rnams ngo mtshar te/ dad pa'i spu long dpag med g.yo ba dag grub pa'i nang bzhugs rab gnas mnga' 'bul shis brjod sogs grangs mang spyir mdzad cing*/ khyad par rje nyid kyis bden gsol dang brtan bzhugs phul ba'i dus/ dngul sku las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga phyogs thams cad du 'phros pa kun gyi mthun snang la grub cing 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char sogs bab pas/ der gnas pa thams cad dad pa'i chu mtsho chen po gsar du brdol zhes grags so// de dang de'i dus su bdag mdo khams nas zhabs drung du sleb nas/ rje nyid kyis kyang kun gyi nang nas brtse bas bskyangs shing*/ bdag nyid kyang rje rin po che 'di dang mjal zhing gsung gi dga' ston snang ba 'di/ sa thob pa'am/ mir gyur pa 'di don dang ldan no bsam pa'i dga' ba thob cing lus ngag gi longs spyod gang yod phyag tu btang bas/

mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes par gyur nas/ gsung nas kyang kho bo yab sras sngon du yang thugs phyogs gcig tu bskyed pa yin/ de lta yang phyogs gcig tu smon lam 'debs pa yin gsung zhing*/ smon lam rgya mtsho yang spel shing*/ de'i dngos po che chung thams cad rten mchog nyid kyi khongs su 'gro ba'i bkod pa yang mdzad cing*/ de dang de dag gi phyag g.yog phal cher dang*/ lha rnams ji ltar grub pa bzhin gyi gsang ba rab gnas dpal 'bri gung pa'i phyag bzhes sku bzhi mar grags pa'i phyag bzhes ltar du bsgrub pa'i zhal bkod phra ba nas bka' ji lta bar bsgrub pa'i khur kyang bdag gis byas shing*/ khyad par gnod sbyin chen po'i 'khor lo dpa' bo gcig sgrub nas bshad pa ltar/ legs par grub pa'i bsgrub pa'ang nges shes 'drongs par byas nas legs par bsgrigs pa la/ gter chen po'i bum pa rin po che'i rig byed sna tshogs pas gang ba/ 'bru sna tshogs dang bcas nas mngon par bkod pa yang*/ gter gyi khang bzang dngos dang mtshungs par bzhugs te/ re re'i zhib rgyas dkar chag tu bkod pa bzhin no// de ltar padma'i ldum rdzing chen mo nas brtsams nas lha lugs ma re re bzhin du'ang*/ nang rdzongs kyi rim pa yang tshang la go rim ma log pa gnod sbyin gyi 'khor lo re re yang phul nas rab tu gnas pa de/ dngos gzhi ni rje rin po che nyid kyis mdzad pa'i phyag phyir dge slong rje 'dzin pa grangs mang snam sbyar gyi rgyal mtshan thogs pa rnams kyis me tog gtor nas shis pa brjod cing mnga' gsol ba dang bcas la/ rje nyid kyi bka' drin thob pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma grub thob brgyad cus gtso byas pa'i gdung rgyud rin po che'i rim pa rje nyid yan dang*/ sngar smos pa'i gter mgon gyi bar rnams mtshan dpe'i yon tan dang bcas pa phrin las mtha' dag gis brgyan pa'i skur grub par gyur te/
