de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi gsang ba'i mdzod dang*/ gter chen po dri ma med pa'i chos sku gtsang bdag bde rtag gi pha rol son pa/ dus gsum dus med kyi sku can khyab brdal chen po'i rang byung phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug rang gsal gyi mchod sdong*/ lha dang mi'i gtsug gi nor bu dri ma med pa 'di nyid las gzhan pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten gyi rnam pa gzhan med cing*/ 'di nyid 'gro ba'i mchod bstod bkur ba'i zhing mchog dam pa dpal kha sbyor zung 'jug yan lag bdun ldan gyi sku lhun gyis grub cing*/ 'gro ba'i mos ba ji lta ba bzhin du re ba bskong bar byed pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i gter mchog 'di 'dra/ srid gsum kun tu ma mchis zhing*/ mtshungs pa dang bral ba'i sprul pa'i sku'i nyer len kun nas mdzes pa'i rang bzhin can/ phyi nang gsang ba sna tshogs/ sngags dang phyag rgya la sogs rnam pa du mas bsngags pa'i 'od zer stong ldan/ mgon po sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams kyis legs sbyar snying po mchog las byung ba'i mchod rten gang*/ dpal ldan dge ba'i bkra shis yon tan sgo brgyar ldan pa 'di dag go// de ltar rgyal mchog sprul pa'i sku rin po che 'di nyid kyis dpal gyi bkra shis sgo mang lha tshogs bzhengs su gsol ba'i rig byed dpag tu med cing grangs mang la mkhas pa dag gis/ rin po che'i mchod sdong chen po mtho skor gyi rgyar ni mtho brgyad cu rtsa brgyad/ mtho dma' dpangs kyi char mtho brgya lhag pa/ 'dul ba lung gi gnas mal gnas kyi gzhi las bshad pa lta bu/ rgyu yi rang bzhin ni rin po che sna tshogs pa ma tshang ba med par 'tshogs pas/ dper na gser gyi ri bo chen po byi dor yang dang yang du byas pa la/ rin po che'i rigs mi gcig pa'i phra ni/ dper na mtshan mo nam mkha' yongs su dag pa la/ rgyu skar rnam par bkra ba ltar mdzes shing*/

ze rog zur chen dang*/ nyi zla la sogs pa'i phra ni nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'od ltar 'phro ba/ zar bu rnams la 'od me stag dang skar chen ltar 'phro ba dang bcas pas spras pa/ mdor na gser gyi ri bo 'od 'phro ba ltar mngon par mtho ba'i mchod sdong sa gsum na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba/ de'i dbu'i gtsug tu gser gdugs bkra shis 'khyil ba rgya khyon dang ldan pa la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa zar bu la phyi nang gi mchod lha dang*/ bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad kyis spras pas legs par brgyan pa'i dbu rtse lha khang ri mo'i 'du byed kyis spras pa'i rtse mor shing bzo'i bkod pa khyad par du 'phags shing seng ge dang*/ chu srin ga ru ḍaḥrngam shing bkra ba dag gis khur ba'i rgya phibs la gser thog rgya tshad chen po'i ngos kyi zar bu rnams la bkra shis rdzas brgyad/ rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun/ gzhan yang mchod lha sna tshogs dang*/ phyogs bzhir de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi dang ldan zhing*/ de'i steng du gser 'phru chen po nam mkha'i rtse mo snyog pa lta bus mngon par mtho ba la/ nang bzhugs gsang ba ring bsrel dang bcas pas brgyan nas/ g.yas g.yon du gser bya chen mo lhun sdug cing spu mdzes pa snyan pa'i sgra 'byin pa dang bcas pas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten gyi dpal dang 'byor ba thams cad dbang du 'gyur zhing*/ zil gyis gnon pa'i rten 'brel bla na med pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa rlabs po ches byin gyis brlabs nas rten mchog 'di nyid bzhengs pa'i gnas skabs phrin las bzhi dang*/ mthar thug sku bzhi ye shes lnga lhun grub tu byung ba ni/ de yang zhi ba'i las rten mchog 'di dbu btsugs pa nas/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag zhi bar gyur nas/ rgyas pa'i las ni mdzad pa phrin las thams cad ches cher rgyas nas/ gang gis kyang 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba dang*/

dbang gi las ni/ 'di yi dus stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ smad mdo khams sgang drug ru bzhi dbus kyi rgyal khams thams cad dbang du 'dus zhing*/ longs spyod kyi dngos po thams cad 'bad med du char bzhin babs nas zad mi shes pa'i gter dang mtshungs pa'o// drag po'i las ni 'di nyid kyi dus/ bstan pa'i dgrar gyur pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du dpal 'bri gung pa'i zhabs 'dren sgrub pa'i 'ol stag gi dpung thams cad phye mar brlag cing*/ jo bo 'o de gung rgyal gyis lug gu mang po phul ba rmi lam du byung bas/ rdzong dpon pa dpon g.yog thams cad 'gugs pa'i sbyor ba byas pa ltar/ zhabs drung du khrid pa dang*/ rje nyid la zhabs 'dren snying nas bsgrub par rtsom pa'i dga' ldan a bsod dang*/ bshag pa la sogs pa'i ngan par sems par byed pa'i gtso bo de dag ni dpal mgon po 'khor bcas dang*/ bka' srung chen mos dngos su bsgral ba'i mgo snying rmi lam du khyer byung bas/ de ma thag rang srog rang gis bcad pa ltar/ g.yog ris kyis bsad pa dang*/ de mthun gyi dgra bo thams cad mog mog por btang bas na/ rje 'di mngon spyod drag po'i pha mthar son pa dpal mgon po nyid do// zhes dang*/ rten mchog 'di ni g.yul lam bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod sdong chen po zhes thams cad kyis tshad mar mnga' gsol bas/ de ltar phrin las bzhi dang ldan zhing*/ mthar thug sku bzhi ye shes lngar grub pa ni/ chos kyi sku spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa/ dpal kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan khyab bdag chen po longs sku'i lha tshogs grub pa dang*/ gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pa'i sku mchog dman sna tshogs bsam mi khyab grub pa dang*/ ngo bo nyid ni sku gsum zung 'jug rang byung gi ye shes rang rig phyag rgya chen po dri ma dang bral ba ste/ de ltar gzhi dus byang chub kyi sems gnyis rin po che las grub cing*/

lam dus tshogs gnyis rin po che'i khang bzang*/ gnas skabs phrin las bzhi dang*/ mthar thug sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i ratna tsarya'i mchod sdong lha mi'i gtsug rgyan 'di'i phyogs su gang zhig gus pa'i sgo nas chen por gyur pa dang*/ cung zad tsam dngos po song ba 'di la lus ngag gi sgo nas 'brel bar gyur pa rdul phran gyi cha shas tsam gyis kyang*/ byang chub kyi sa bon bzhag par gyur cing*/ gang dang gang gis lus kyi las/ tha na gzhan gyis dbang med du bskul ba la yang rnam par dkar ba'i 'bras bu 'byin par 'gyur ba gdon mi za ste/ gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten yungs 'bru tsam la bsti stang bkur sti byas pa lta zhog gis/ sems can rmongs pa dag gis ma bsam mi shes par bskor ba byas pa'am/ gas pa bsubs pas kyang lha mi'i lus thob par 'gyur na/ skye bo gang zhig gus pa'i sems kyis bzhengs sam/ phyag dang bskor ba bsti stang dang rim gro byas pas ni phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro// zhes bka' bstsal to/ zhes pa ltar ro// de lta bas na ratna tsarya'i mchod sdong chen po 'di nyid de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan pa ltar/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyis kyang mchod rten bye ba byas pa dang*/ de'i byed pa rgyu mthun gyis byang phyogs rgyud du de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten rin po che sna tshogs las bsgrubs nas sems can gyi mchod pa'i rten dang*/ dkon mchog gsum rgyun mi 'chad cing*/ snying po'i bstan pa gsal bar byed pa'i dge slong dag 'byung ste/ de ni nā gardzu na'i rnam par 'phrul pa'o// zhes dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung pas lung bstan nas/ paṇa chen shākya shrī yab sras kyi gtam rgyud las 'byung ba ltar shes byed tshad ldan du 'dug pas/ de'i phyir skyob pa 'di nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten 'di/ gang gis mthong dang thos pa dang*/ bkur sti rim gro bgyid pa dag gis sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun te dkon mchog gsum la rgyun chad med pa'i 'khor los/

'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du phan bde rin po che'i gzhir gyur pa'o// de ltar rten mchog 'di nyid sbrul lo la dbu btsugs nas/ bya lo'i khongs su 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi nas rtse'i nyi zla bya ru'i bar gyi lha lugs ma dang*/ 'phrul ma la sogs mtha' dag legs par grub cing*/ nang bzhugs kyi rim pa dang*/ nang gi shing sgrig pa/ de'i steng du ji ltar bkod pa'i bang rim bdun sgrigs pa la sogs pa'i dus kyang*/ rje rin po che nyid yab sras dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen phyag g.yog pa rnams dang*/ bdag cag thams cad kyis gus pa chen pos bsgrubs shing*/ khyad par dga' ston dang rab gnas chen mo'ang dus sbyor bzang po dang sprad nas/ rje rin po che khu dbon gyis thog drangs yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen snam sbyar gyi rgyal mtshan thogs pa brgya phrag mang pos zhabs 'bring bsgrubs nas/ rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i rab gnas kyis rab tu gnas pa mnga' dbul dang bcas pa bsgrubs shing*/ rig byed pa rnams la'ang dpon chen rdor rgyal bas thog drangs thams cad la nye bar 'tsham pa'i gnang cha'i rim pa ni/ bkra shis kha btags kha dog sna lnga rtags brgyad kyis mtshan pa/ rgya gar gyi li mas gtsos pa'i rten gsum mchod rdzas tshang ma dang bcas pa/ rin po che rin thang med pa mang po dang*/ gos dar/ ber phyi nang*/ gan dkar/ dngul spyad sogs gsol chas tshang ma/ gzim gur dkar nag sogs sgar chas tshang ma/ rten kheb bla bres sogs dar yol 'bol gdan sogs gzim chas bskor tshang ma/ nang khrab sgrom ral sogs dpag med/ rgya ja sig brgya phrag lhag pa/ chibs dang drel grangs mang*/ mdzo phyugs grangs las 'das pa ste/ mdor na bzo rig pa thams cad kyi yid kyi shing rta gang nas/ dpon chen rdo rje rgyal pos kyang*/ 'di lta bu gnang ba pos gnang rgyu yod kyang*/ nged len pa pos blor mi shong zer nas/ slar rin po che nyid la dngos po bzang dgu phud du phul nas/

dbang dang gdams pa zhus zhing*/ zhabs spyi bor blangs nas skye ba dang skye bar zhabs 'bring sgrub bo zhes khas blangs shing smon lam btab ste mi phyed pa'i dad pa phun sum tshogs pa thob par gyur zhing*/ der gnas pa'i skye bo dang*/ 'dus pa rgya mtsho la'ang*/ dga' ston gyi khyad par dpag tu med pa dang*/ dngos po'i gdab len che rag chung tshang gis ji ltar 'os pa bzhin mi zad pa'i gter bzhin mdzad pa ni/ ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar rmad du byung ba kho na ste/ de lta bu'i 'dus pa dang*/ bzo rig ji snyed pa dag gis 'gro 'ong byas kyang*/ longs spyod la 'phel ba las cung zad kyang nongs pa mi mnga' zhing ches cher rgyas par gyur pa ni/ phrin las mi zad pa'i rgyan gyi 'khor lo/ rnam par dag pa dang ldan pas/ lha mi thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bur lta bu zla bral du bkur bas/ skye bo phrag dog can chos ltar bcos pa dag gis/ dug chu mngar mos/ sgom pa'i khur 'dzin dbon byams pa chos kyis rgyal mtshan 'khor bcas bslus nas/ ri bo dge ldan pa 'khor bcas kyis zhabs 'dren sgrub par brtsams pa la/ rje 'di nyid kyis rtsod pa chos kyi phyogs su zhi bar mdzad cing*/ rin po che nyid zab mo'i rnal 'byor las skad cig kyang mi g.yo bar mdzad nas/ lugs gnyis kyis zhabs 'bring ji snyed pa ni/ mi dbang mgon po rgyal mtshan nyid kyis bsgrubs shing*/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan dam pa/ dbon rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos zur 'chad kyis khur bzhes/ gling rin po che'i dgun chos kyi ras phud sogs bkod pas khyab par mdzad nas/ lugs gnyis kyi dpal 'byor chen po nyi zla ltar rgyas par bzhugs shing*/ de ka'i mod la gser gdugs bkra shis 'khyil pa bzo ba la pho nya ba btang nas/ dpon chen chos skyong gis mgos byas pa'i gzo rig pa rnams bkug nas/ bzo thab lha khang chen mor btsugs pa dang*/

tsan dan dkar dmar gyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis/ rgya nag gi bkod pa/ rkos mkhan mkhas pa phul du phyin pa/ dpon mo che pa ngag dbang grags pas legs par bsgrubs pa'i zhal bkod bla na med pa'ang gnang zhing*/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la'ang*/ zab mo'i chos kyis rgyud grol ba'i thabs kho na la 'bad cing*/ bkod pas khyab par gnang ba ni/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che/ dgos sgrub brgyud 'di'i bstan pa gces par 'dzin pa'i phyir du/ chos las skyes pa'i sras mchog bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin cing*/ lung rigs rtogs pa'i pha rol du son pa'i skyes mchog chen po zur 'chad pa nyi ma shar ba lta bu rnams so sor bsko bzhag gi rim pa rnams kyang zhal bkod gnang sbyin sogs kyis khyab par ni mdzad/ thugs kyi dgongs pa rin po che gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos rtsod pa dang bral zhing tshad ma las kyang tshad mar gyur pa'i gsung rgyun nor bu'i phreng ba lta bu ni legs par bkod/ blang dor gyi mig 'byed par byed pa'i bka' srol ston pa'i gsung yig gang gis mthong na ngo mtshar zhing bkur ba'i gnas su gyur pa nor bu'i phreng ba lta bu ni/ gtsug lag gnyis dang mthun par mdzad/ shes dang shes par bya ba'i dmigs su gyur pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i rgyun chen po ni bcas/ phrin las mi zad pa spel ba'i lam srol gzhal du med pa ni gsal bar mdzad/ chos ltar 'chos pa'i skye bo mang po ni ring du dor/ chos ldan gyi skyes bu dam pa ni rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar mngon par bstod cing bkur bar mdzad nas/ skye bo dregs pa can thams cad ni zil gyis mnan cing pham par gyur nas/ dman pa'i sems kyi zhabs spyi bor len pa dang*/ yang 'ga' zhig lta sgom spyod pa gsum ya bral nas/ stong pa'i lta ba gtso bor smra zhing*/ rgyu 'bras khas mi len par tho co sna tshogs dang bab col du 'dod yon lnga la wa mo ltar bzhabs la spyod pa dag ni/

stong nyid rgyu 'bras seng ge'i ngar skad kyis rgyang ring du byer bar byas shing*/ 'ga' zhig sgom bde gsal gyis nyams la mchog tu zhen nas mngon shes phra mo tsam la mthar thug gi dngos grub tu rloms nas/ rtsig bu dang chu lud du sgom pa'i nga rgyal chen pos/ tshul khrims rin po che dang*/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab khyad du gsod pa dag la/ zung 'jug mtha' bral chen po'i gdams ngag gis/ rnyog ma can gyi bsam gtan gyi dri ma mthar dbyung bar mdzad/ 'ga' zhig nyan thos kyi tshul khrims mig 'bras bzhin du bsrung zhing zab mo'i lta sgom khyad du gsod pa dag la/ tshul khrims rin po che dang phyag rgya chen po dbyer med kyi gdams pas rtog ge dmigs bcas kyis dpyod pa dag so sor pham par mdzad cing*/ lta sgom spyod gsum zung 'jug gcig tu ston pa'i nyams len sdom gsum gnad gcig gi man ngag rgyud pa chu bo gsum 'dres kyis gdams pa'i gnad phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i lam po che'i srol ches cher gsal bar gyur pa ni/ khyad du 'phags pa'i rnam par thar pa zad mi shes pa dang ldan pa nyid de/ de ltar khams gsum gyi mgon po 'di nyid kyis slob pa dang mi slob pa'i 'khor gyi 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu la rnam par grol ba'i lam mchog gis rgyud grol bar mdzad pa la skyo ngal spangs pa'i ston pa chen po 'dis/ log par lta ba mtha' dag ni drung nas phyung zhing*/ yang dag pa'i lta ba ni mkha' la nyi ma shar ba ltar khyab par mdzad pas/ 'jig rten na mig 'byed kyi ston pa gcig por gyur pa thams cad mkhyen pa chen po rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po 'di nyid kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba rlabs po che ni mdzad pa'o// dpal 'bri gung chen po'i sngon gyi bka' srol thams cad phrin las bzhi'i sgo nas rgyas par ni mdzad/ gangs can gyi sgrub brgyud thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu zla bral du ni gyur/

bstan pa dang bstan pa'i sgo ji snyed pa dag ni kun gyis gtso bor gyur pa rgyal dbang dbon rin po che dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu chen po rnams la gtad cing*/ zhing 'di yi gdul bya rnams yongs su rdzogs shing*/ zhing gzhan du 'gro don rgya che bar dgongs nas/ nye gnas chen po mi dbang mgon po rgyal mtshan pa la sogs la/ thabs dang thabs kyis zhal bkod/ khrims dge ba bcu'i lam gyi rim pa dang*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bslab bya gang dang gang zhig dang*/ khyad par dpal 'bri gung pa'i sde ris la sogs rang phyogs byams pas skyong zhing*/ gzhan phyogs srid du 'dzin thabs/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i lta sgom spyod gsum dri ma med pa 'di dag la bsre slad med par 'dzin par byed pa la sogs kyi rim pa rnams zhib rgyas su phebs cing*/ thams cad la'ang 'dus byas snying po med pa'i gdams pa mang po gnang*/ chab tshan khar drung 'khor phebs nas kyang skyo shas dang nyams mgur mang po mdzad pa dang*/ gzigs snang 'ga' zhig kyang gtan la 'bebs pa sogs mdzad kyang bdag cag thams cad kyi the tshom dang som nyi ma byas la/ rin po che sku bsnyung ba'i rnam pa ni cher med kyang*/ sku shed chung chung mdzad nas/ zhabs drung du yod pa rnams la/ chos kyi 'khor lo tha ma nges don gyi snying po phyag rgya chen po rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid zab mo dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad sems can kyi khams rgyud la bzhugs pa rtag pa'i sku/ bral 'bras ye shes kyi thugs can du bzhugs pa 'di/ mdo sde dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa las bshad pa dang*/ rgyud sde rnams las kyang*/ gzhi 'bras ro gcig gi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa da lta'i rig pa dri ma med pa 'di nyid yin pas 'di la gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad par bgyid 'tshal/ zhes yang dang yang du bka' bstsal chen po bka' bstsal nas/

bdag cag thams cad kyang rang byung gi ye shes bla na med pa'i snying po las kyang snying por gyur pa'i legs bshad dag gis tshim par mdzad cing*/ khyad par skyob pa rin po che nyid zhi bar gshegs pa'i dus ji lta bar lnga bcu rtsa gsum bzhes pa'i phag gi lo hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu skor la bsnyung ba'i tshul mdzad nas/ nyi shu lnga nas sku shed chung ngu la/ khams kyi gsol zas cher med kyang 'tsho ba zhabs drung ba rnams kyis yid ma ches nas/ zhu ba phul na'ang*/ cang mi sto ba'ang cher med gsungs shing*/ da lta nged rang gi dge sbyor la nyin mtshan sogs 'phel 'grib gtan nas mi snang bas/ bde ba rang 'dug gsung ba phebs/ nyi shu dgu nas drag tu bsnyung yang*/ gzim khang rnying mar phebs nas dgu gtor dang*/ mnga' gsol rgyas pa dang*/ mda' dar dang*/ gser gyi rten rdzas phul/ brtan bzhugs mang du mdzad/ rdo sku rin po che la dbu gtugs nas smon lam yun ring du mdzad/ de nas gzims g.yog pa rnams kyis sku bsten nas/ gzims mal du phebs nas/ yun ring du mnyam par bzhag nas/ de ring shin tu legs pa zhig byung gsungs shing*/ tshes gsum bzhi la bsnyung tshul mdzad/ lnga'i nyin mchod rdzas rnams bkod pa dang*/ de'i nub mo yang thugs dam gyi rim pa rnams gcig kyang ma chag par gnang*/ gung thun la yang chag med mdzad/ de'i zhag phyi ma zla ba dgu pa'i tshes drug gi tho rangs kyi cha la yang*/ gsung rgyun rnams kyang mdzad/ de nas gsung ngag grol nas dus kyi snga cha la legs par bzhengs nas khri thog na phebs/ thams cad la rjes dran gsung gsungs nas nyid kyis kyang legs par gsungs shing*/ sku lus drang por srang nas mnyam gzhag gis phyag rgya mdzad te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar mnyam med dwags po rin po che brgyud pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa dngos su gzigs shing*/ mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad nas/ spyan nam mkha'i mthongs su gzigs par mdzad te/

chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor 'od gsal de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog par mdzad pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos nyid mngon du gyur pas/ zab cing spros bral gyi cha la mnyam par bzhag par gyur te/ de'i dus su sa g.yo ba dang*/ me tog gi char dbab pa/ 'ja'i gur phub pas/ yid du 'ong ba'i spos kyi ngad ldang ba sogs ltas dang ya mtshan dpag tu med pa dag byung ba ni brjod kyis mi lang ba'o// de'i dus su bdag cag la sogs pas smre sngags ston pa ni/ kyi hud rje btsun 'gro ba'i mgon// bdag cag 'thoms pa'i skyabs dang mgon// mun bsal sgron me rin po che// thar pa'i lam ston gang du gshegs// ye shes ri bo 'di rnyil nas// bdag cag dpung gnyen gang la brten// sgrub brgyud nyi ma 'di nub pas// log lta'i mun pa gtibs pa na// bsal byed mgon khyod gang du gshegs// kye ma kyi hud mgon khyod kyis// chos sku'i btsan sa zin bzhin du// gzugs sku'i snang brnyan bsdu ba ni// bdag cag byis pa rmongs pa yis// thugs yid skyo bar gyur tam kye// e ma mtshungs med chos kyi rje// chos sku dag pa'i dbyings nyid nas// gzugs sku'i snang brnyan bstan du gsol// snyigs ma'i sems can mi skyob na// khyod kyi thugs rjes ci zhig bya// bdag gis yid ni ku sha yi// 'dab ma 'thor rlung drag po yis// rab tu gtor ba bzhin du gyur// mya ngan zas dang mchi ma yis// nongs shing rtab rtab por gyur nas// 'di bya gtol med dag tu gyur// de nas rje btsun dran pa'i yis// lhong lhong por ni gyur pas na// 'dren 'dun bor nas skyes bu dag /snying ni mkha' 'gros bton pa'i mi// gzugs dag yor yor 'gro ltar gyur/ khyod kyis thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis// khyod dang bdag gis sems nyid gnyis// dbyer med bzhugs pa'i tshul thos pas// slar yang dran pa rnyed gyur cing*// rnam dag dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i thabs// sna tshogs tshul du 'bad par byas// lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i rdzas// sprin spungs bzhin du 'dus pa yi// longs spyod char ltar bab gyur nas// de dang de dag ji snyed pa// thams cad tshogs gnyis spel ba'i phyir// cung zad tsam yang ma god par// gus ldan snying stobs chen po 'chang*// rig shes gnas la ma rmongs pa'i// mi dbang mgon po rgyal mtshan gyis// bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa yis// rnam par bkod pa'i khyad par gyis// ji snyed 'gran dang bral ba yis// 'dus pa'i gtso bo rgyal ba dbon// lugs gnyis khur 'dzin sgom pa'i mtshan// mkhan slob chos gsum spyan drangs pa'i// dge 'dun khri phrag lhag tsam gyis// so so'i rgyud sde rnam dag gi// dkyil 'khor cho ga zhal phye zhing*// sngags kyi mchod 'bul dpag med dang*// rang sems bla ma sangs rgyas nyid// dbyer med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor rnams// gdung ba'i gsol 'debs dus drug gis// mos gus ting 'dzin mchod 'bul bgyid// kha cig mdo sde las byung ba'i// mdo dbyangs che chung la sogs dang*// phyag 'tshal yan lag bdun par 'bad// der gnas skye bo thams cad la// zas dang gos sogs 'jig rten gyi// tha mal rtog pa 'gags gyur nas// lus sems dug bral dge ba yis// sems ni yengs yengs por gyur nas// nyin mtshan dus ni 'da' bar gyur// kha cig 'dra yi mgon po yang*// mi rtag 'da' ba'i tshul ston na// chu shing snying po med 'dra yis// lus can rnams ni smos ci dgos// zhes pa'i gtam gyi skyo shas kyis// tshe 'di'i bya ba ring dor nas// dngos po gang yod phyogs der btang*// rang nyid byang chub sgrub pa la// skad cig g.yel ba med par gyur// 'jig rten skye bo 'dus pa ni// gangs can 'di na 'di lta'i las// mang ba sngon chad ma byung zhes// thams cad mthun par gleng bar nges// de snyed 'dus pa thams cad la// dngos po'i bye brag dpag med kyis// rang rang yid kyi re ba bskang*// yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'gyed chen gyis// khri la blangs pa'i sbyor ba bshams// tshogs gnyis shing rta chen po de// smon lam rnam dag kha bsgyur gyis// gral gyi gtso bor bzhugs pa ni// gangs can 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i gtso// paṇa chen shāka shrī'i ring lugs pa// chos lung tshogs pa'i mkhan chen gyis// legs spel smon lam rgya mtsho bskrun// zag med dgongs pa dbyings su rdzogs// sku gnyis 'gro ba'i don la 'grub// phrin las mi zad 'khor lo de// srid mthar 'byung ba'i thabs tshul mdzad// kye ma skyob pa thugs rje can// rkang gnyis gtso bo thams cad mkhyen// srid zhi'i mgon po 'bri gung pa// rgyal ba'i sras mchog kun dga'i mtshan// khyod nyid chos sku'i dbyings bzhugs nas// gzugs sku'i snang brnyan mi ston na// bdag cag byis pa mya ngan gyis// zug rngus snying ni 'gas 'gyur zhing*// tshe yi 'du byed gtong ba ni// 'gyur ba nyid du the tshom med// 'di 'dra thos pa'ang mi bzod na// mngon sum mthong ba'i rmongs pa bdag

/snying ma gas pa sran che 'am// nyid kyis thugs rjes skyobs sam ci// de phyir brtse ba spangs gyur na// khyod kyis thugs bskyed ma dor ram// smon lam btab pa'ang don med phyir// gang zhig 'bad pa'i 'bras bu nyams// de phyir khyod kyis thugs rje yis// gzugs sku'i snang brnyan bstan du gsol// zhes smos nas/ de ltar khams gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che 'di nyid dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i dus/ dag ma dag gi cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan cing*/ nam mkha' las me tog gi char bab pa la sogs dang*/ me tog gsar du 'khrungs pa dang*/ rtsi shing 'bras bu gsar du 'khrungs pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar zhing*/ de'i lo la dgun med par dbyar dus dang mtshungs par gyur zhing*/ yul gzhan du yang ltas dang*/ cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa dag byung nas/ 'di dang 'di dag gang gis so zhes gleng ba na/ 'bri gung rin po che u rgyan du spyan 'dren phul nas gshegs par mngon no// zhes brjod do// phag lo smin drug zla ba'i tshes drug gi snga dro'i cha la zhi bar gshegs pa nas/ de ma thag tu 'dus pa'i tshogs mang po dang*/ phyogs phyogs kyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen brgya phrag mang pos kyang*/ rang rang gi rdzas longs spyod dpag tu med pa dang*/ mchod sprin rgya mtsho thogs nas mngon par phyogs par gyur te mngon par mchod do// zhag bdun phrag gnyis kyi bar du/ 'od gsal chen por bzhugs nas/ 'od zer gyi spro bsdu mang po dag kyang byung ngo*// de nas dbon rnam pa gnyis dang*/ khur bzhes kyi gtso bo mi dbang mgon po rgyal mtshan nyid kyis mdzad te/ 'bri gung pa'i mnga' 'og tu gtogs pa'i lha sde mi sde thams cad dang khyad par dbus gtsang gi btsad po thams cad dang*/ stag lung lha sde mi sde thams cad dang*/ kong lung ral gsum la sogs thams cad dang*/ byang ris kyi mi dpon sgom sde sogs thams cad kyis rnam thos kyi bu la 'gran pa'i longs spyod dag gis gter chen po brdol ba la/

gang la gang 'tsham gyi bza' btung longs spyod dpag tu med pas tshim zhing*/ dge 'dun khri phrag lhag pa'i ser sogs dang chog mang gong ma'i bka' srol ji snyed pa las ches cher lhag pa'i bkod pa dag dang*/ 'gyed chen kyang mi'i 'dus pa khri phrag mang po dag grangs las 'das pa la/ gos dar/ snam ras/ sman/ mdzo/ rta/ gri/ khrab mang po/ nas kyi phung po de'u che shos tsam dang bcas te legs par bkye ba las/ khrom de tsam gyi 'dus pa la'ang mi gnyis kyang 'thab par ma byung ste/ thams cad kyis 'di lta bu ni rin po che nyid kyis thugs rjer nges so zhes gleng ba sha stag go// de nas sku gdung rin po che zhugs la zhen pa'i bka' bgro ba la/ dad can thams cad kyis sku gdung rin po che 'di 'gro ba thams cad kyi dmigs rten du gling rin po che rang du bzhugs su gsol zhes bka' bgros nas/ re zhig rin po che dmar po'i za ma tog gi nang du gdan drangs nas/ dri bzang sna tshogs kyi chus sku khrus legs par gsol zhing*/ ka shi ka'i ras bzang po dri'i chus sbags pa'i na bza' gsol nas/ mchod rdzas dang lha'i na bza' sna tshogs gsol te/ dge slong dri ma med pa bzhi sdes mchod pa dang mar me rgyun chags nyi shu tsam dang bcas te/ mtshe'u khar lo 'khyud ma gcig bzhugs su gsol lo// de'i tshe yang me tog gi char dang*/ ri bong la sogs mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba mang pos kyang phyag dang mchod pa dang rol mo'i sgra sngon ma thos pa mang po grags pa dang*/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub pa sogs ngo mtshar gzhal du med pa rgyun mi 'chad du byung ngo*// de nas gangs dkar rgyal po ti se la gser 'bum dang*/ mtsho chen ma dros pa la sku bal gyi ring bsrel mang po dang*/ tshems gcig dang bcas pa gser gyi ga'u'i nang du bzhugs pa la rin po che sna tshogs dang sman bzang drug sogs kyis bkang ba'i mtsho mchod dang bcas/ 'dan ma rtogs ldan chen po kun dga' grags pa dpon slob brdzangs pa phyin/

dbus gtsang gi bka' brgyud rin po che'i dgon sde/ dpal gyi dwags la sgam po dang*/ gdan sa phag mo gru la sogs pa rnams la mang ja 'gyed bcas/ sku 'dra rin po che rnams la snyan dar mar me sogs grangs mang ba gnas chen tsā ri/ la phyi 'phags pa shing kun la gdugs 'gyogs pa ste/ de dag gi ri pa rdo rje 'dzin pa dang bcas pa rnams la tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang 'bul 'gyed chen po rnams ni/ mdor na gong ma zhi bar gshegs pa rnams kyis dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa bsgrubs pa la/ rin po che 'di nyid kyi dgongs rdzogs las rgya che ba dang myur ba ma byung 'dug pa/ de lta bu thams cad zla ba phyed gnyis kyi nang du mya ngan bsal byed kyi gser sku thub pa longs spyod rdzogs sku mda' gang ma gcig dang bcas te grub pa dang*/ de ka'i mod la tshogs kyi dar sku sman dang dar zab las grub pa'i sku tshad lhag cig legs par grub la/ nang bzhugs zhabs bsdoms rab gnas sogs tshul dang mthun pa phul nas/ lha rdzas kyi yo byad sna tshogs dang*/ na bza' bzhugs gdan sogs bkod pa'i khyad par du 'phags pa dang*/ rje rin po che'i rnam par thar pa'i ri mo khyad par du 'phags pa rnams legs par grub cing*/ khyad par dngul gdung rin po che rgya khyon dang ldan pa la rin po che'i rigs byed rin thang can mang po'i phras yongs su bskor zhing*/ gser ga rin thang can gyis spras pa la/ bum stod smad kyi mtshams la/ rje nyid kyi sku mu tig las grub pa'i spyad rnams gser gan mas byas pa mtho skor gyi tshad grub pa/ seng ge'i khri rin po che la chos skyong dang nor lha'i bkod pas bteg cing mchod lha du mas bskor bar byas pa'i nang rin po che dmar po'i za ma tog gi nang du/ sman dang dar zab kyi shin tu bklubs shing rin po che'i cod paṇa dang bcas nas bzhugs su gsol ba'i steng du/ rin po che'i gser gdugs las bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa gtso bo dngul gar lugs su byas pa rgya khyon dang ldan pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong bas spras pa dang bcas nas legs par grub pa ni shin tu ngo mtshar zhing lha dang mi'i mchod sdong bla na med pa'i 'dzam gling rgyan mchog tu grags pa la/

phyi nang gi mchod rdzas du mas mngon par spras nas bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ de dang cha mnyam du gzim mal gser sku bzo khyad ldan zhing byin chags pa shin tu ngo mtshar ba sku tshad las ches cher lhag pa'ang grub pa nang bzhugs rab gnas sogs mtha' dag dus chen steng du mngon par grub par byas zhing*/ dus dang dus kyi mchod pa bstan pa rin po che'i rgyun dang bcas shing nyid kyi thugs rje dang phrin las kyi lhag ma srid mtha'i bar du rgyun mi 'chad pa nam mkha'i lto ba 'gengs par mdzad do// 'dir smras pa/ skyob pa khyod kyi thugs rje'i phrin las ni// mkha' dang mnyam zhing 'gran pa'i zla bral ba// bsam mi khyab cing lhun gyis grub pa can// gsang ba gsum gyi mdzod 'dzin rin po che// sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro 'di 'dul slad du// rnam 'phrul mtha' yas cir yang ston mdzad pas// rnam mkhyen rgyal ba khyod kyi mdzad pa'i sgo// dpag med brjod pa'i grangs las 'das pa po// rnam 'phrul cir yang 'char ba e ma mtshar// de lta mod kyis bdag blo'i me long 'dir// gsal bar shar gyur gang snang thugs rje'i mthus// rnam par brjod 'di da lta'i rnam thar ro// ma 'ongs na'ang mdzad pa ji snyed pa// mtha' yas bstan pa gang yin 'dir smos na// rlabs chen rgyal ba'i spyod pa grangs med spyod// mchog dman mdzad pa'i snang brnyan dpag med kyis// sangs rgyas zhing khams rab 'byams grangs med par// rdzu 'phrul bkod pa sna tshogs cir yang ston// la lar 'khor dang la lar gtso bo dang*// zhi dang khro sogs gang 'dul gzugs kyis kyang*// de snyed 'gro ba thabs kyi 'dren par mdzad// gsung gcig la'ang sgra skad rgya mtsho yis// theg pa'i 'jug sgo thabs tshul du ma yis// rang rang yid kyi re ba yongs skong ba'i// gsang ba chen po bsam mi khyab pa brnyes// chos dbyings bsam mi khyab pa'i ting 'dzin las// shes bya mtha' dag cig car mkhyen pa'i sgo// mi zad blo las 'das pa'i ye shes kyis// ting 'dzin ji snyed sgo la 'jug pa can// sangs rgyas yon tan kun la dbang 'byor nas// phrin las srid mthar 'gro ba sgrol ba po// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang dbyer med pas// 'gro ba'i mgon po bla ma'i ma 'ongs pa'i// rnam thar mi zad rgyan 'khor ldan pa 'di// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i bdag nyid lags// de ltar khams gsum gyi mgon po chen po de nyid zhing 'di nas zhing gzhan du gshegs pa yang mchog dman sna tshogs par sprul par mdzad pa ni/

shar phyogs mi bskyod pa'i zhing du gshegs shing der yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas nas bzhugs pa dang*/ yang rtogs ldan mngon par shes pa mnga' ba dag gi rgya gar du phyi nang gi bstan par rtsod pa na/ nang pa pham pas der/ mu stegs pa 'dul ba'i slad du mkha' 'gro mas gdan drangs nas sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa 'dzin par dri ma med pa'i dge slong dag tu sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa dang*/ gzhan du na u rgyan du mkha' 'gro mas seng ge'i khri la bteg nas spyan drangs nas 'khor dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro mang po'i tshogs dbus su bzhugs pa dang*/ yang lung bstan kha cig dang*/ nyid kyi gsung sgros dang bka' brgyud 'di'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong la ngal ba spangs pas/ slar zhing 'di nyid du skye ba bzhes nas sems can mang po theg chen skye med kyi sa la bkod pa'i tshul bstan pa sogs grangs mang zhing dpag par dka' ba'i sku'i bkod pa sna tshogs kyi sgo nas sems can gyi don la ngal ba spangs pa'i rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po rnams/ spyod pa rlabs po ches 'gro ba'i khur bzhes pa ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'o// de ltar khams gsum gyi mgon po skyob pa rin po che kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po gang de'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las 'khor dang zhing gi yon tan gyi bkod pa la sogs pa mtha' dag ni/ rgyal sras rnams kyis kyang dpag par dka' zhing*/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal dag gi spyod yul las 'das zhing dpag par dka' na/ bdag cag so so skye bos smos ci dgos/ 'on kyang rje nyid kyis zhal nas snga phyir ji ltar gsungs pa dang*/ dam pa gong ma rnams kyis ji ltar bkod pa'i yig cha dag dang*/ bdag cag dad ldan rnams kyis ji ltar mthong zhing rtogs pa ji snyed pa rnams/ rgyal ba de nyid kyi bstan pa rin po che 'phel zhing rgyas par bya ba dang*/

gus ldan skye bo dad pa'i lang tsho gsar du bskyed par bya ba'i phyir du/ khams gsum gyi mgon po skyob pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa phan bde'i 'byung gnas bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba 'di nyid mngon par bkod pa'o// 'dir smras pa/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba gcig bsdus pa// klu rigs sgrol mar mngon par sangs rgyas dang*// klu sgrub snying po bde gshegs rin chen dpal// de nyid gnyis pa skyob pa kun dga'i mtshan// gang de'i rnam thar dgos 'dod rin chen gter// bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po 'di bkod pas// mtha' yas skye dgu 'gro ba ma lus pa// tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs sgrib kun rnam dag nas// zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang thob par shog /'di yis dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun// skye dang skye bar mgon po 'bri gung pa'i// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin cing*// bstan pa rin chen phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /mnyam med bla ma'i rnam thar dri med 'di// dad pa'i shugs kyis yi ger bkod pa la// rang bzo sgro bskur nyes skyon ci mchis dang*// zlos skyon sdebs ma legs dang nongs pa rnams// gong ma rnams dang mkhas la bzod par gsol// rnam dkar dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dges// rnam grol thar pa'i gnas su bgrod byas nas// rnam dag sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang*// rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par shog /

ces rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo gcig tu 'dus pa'i bdag nyid/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa phan bde rin po che'i 'byung gnas bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba 'di nyid/ rje nyid kyis brtse bar bskyangs shing*/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa shākya'i dge slong bsod nams rgya mtshos/ byi ba lo hor zla brgyad pa'i yar tshes bzang po la/ gzhu stod sgru sgang gi yang dgon gyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong thar pa rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis pa'o// 'dis kyang dpal 'bri gung pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig// /maṅgalaṃ//
